title.en: Version 4.4 "Nameless Honor" Update
title.id: Update "Kehormatan Tanpa Nama" Versi 4.4

desc.en: Dear Trailblazers, During the event, Trailblazers can increase their Nameless Honor level to obtain rewards such as Star Rail Passes, Self-Modeling Resins, and Tracks of Destiny. After unlocking Nameless Glory, you will immediately obtain Stellar Jade ×680. In addition, increasing Nameless Honor levels will allow Trailblazers to obtain Light Cone Memory Shard ×1, Star Rail Special Pass ×4, a 4-star Light Cone of your choice, Variable Dice ×1, Self-Modeling Resin ×2, Relic Remains, the universal Path material Tears of Dreams, and more! If the Trailblazer unlocks the Nameless Medal, in addition to the previous rewards, they will immediately increase their Honor level by 10, and obtain the avatar Himeko • Nova: Literary, the avatar Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae: Literary, Light Cone Memory Shard ×1, Stellar Jade ×200, and Fuel rewards! Start Date After the Version 4.4 update — 2026/08/24 03:59:00 Participation Requirements Trailblaze Level ≥ 12 and have completed the Trailblaze Mission "Jarilo-VI — Long Wait for the Blade's Edge" About Nameless Honor After Nameless Honor is unlocked, the Nameless Gift will automatically be unlocked. Trailblazers can obtain EXP and increase their Nameless Honor level via This Week's Missions and This Period's Missions. The maximum Nameless Honor level is capped at Level 70. Attaining specific levels will allow the Trailblazer to obtain Star Rail Passes, Self-Modeling Resin, Tracks of Destiny, and more. This Week's Missions will reset every Monday at 04:00 (server time). Trailblazers who have unlocked the Nameless Glory can purchase Honor Badge to upgrade to Nameless Medal. Attention After reaching level cap, EXP will no longer be awarded through missions during this period. In the event of special circumstances leading to the repeated purchase of Nameless Glory or Nameless Medal, The Nameless EXP will not be accumulated, and Oneiric Shards ×750 (or Oneiric Shards ×1,410) will be refunded depending on the price of the purchase. In the event of special circumstances leading to the repeated purchase of the Honor Badge, Oneiric Shards ×860 will be refunded. The purchase of Nameless Glory, Nameless Medal, and Honor Badge will be closed for this period at 2026/08/24 02:59:00 . After the purchase is closed, Trailblazers can still complete the Nameless Honor missions and receive rewards. Please note the available purchase time and event period. In the webpage top-up center, the purchase deadline for Nameless Glory, Nameless Medal, and Honor Badge will be 2026/08/23 03:59:00 . Trailblazers who top up on the webpage should pay attention to the purchase availability time.
desc.id: Dear Trailblazer, Selama event berlangsung, Trailblazer dapat meningkatkan level "Kehormatan Tanpa Nama" untuk memperoleh Star Rail Pass, Self-Modeling Resin, Tracks of Destiny dan hadiah lainnya. Setelah membuka "Nameless Glory", kamu akan langsung mendapatkan Stellar Jade ×680. Tingkatkan level "Kehormatan Tanpa Nama" untuk memperoleh tambahan Light Cone Memory Shard ×1, Star Rail Special Pass ×4, Light Cone 4★ yang diinginkan, Variable Dice ×1, Self-Modeling Resin ×2, Relic Remains, Material Path Umum "Tears of Dreams", dan hadiah lainnya! Jika Trailblazer membuka "Nameless Medal", maka selain hadiah yang di atas, Trailblazer dapat langsung menaikkan 10 level Kehormatan Tanpa Nama, juga memperoleh hadiah avatar "Himeko • Nova: Aroma Buku", avatar "Dan Heng · Imbibitor Lunae: Aroma Buku", Light Cone Memory Shard ×1, Stellar Jade ×200, dan Fuel! Waktu Dibuka Setelah update Versi 4.4 - 2026/08/24 03:59:00 Syarat Partisipasi Level Trailblaze ≥ Lv. 12 dan telah menyelesaikan Misi Trailblaze "Jarilo-Ⅵ" - "Penantian Lama Menunggu Ujung Pisau" Penjelasan "Kehormatan Tanpa Nama" Setelah membuka "Kehormatan Tanpa Nama", "Nameless Gift" akan terbuka secara otomatis. Trailblazer dapat memperoleh EXP untuk meningkatkan Level Kehormatan Tanpa Nama dengan cara menyelesaikan Misi Minggu Ini dan Misi Periode Ini. Maksimum level Kehormatan Tanpa Nama adalah Lv. 70. Setelah mencapai Level Kehormatan Tanpa Nama yang ditentukan, Trailblazer akan mendapatkan Star Rail Pass, Self-Modeling Resin, Tracks of Destiny, dan hadiah lainnya. Misi Minggu Ini akan reset setiap hari Senin pukul 04:00 (waktu server). Jika perlu, Trailblazer yang telah membuka "Nameless Glory" dapat meng-upgrade ke "Nameless Medal" dengan membeli "Honor Badge". Perhatian Selama event ini berlangsung, Trailblazer tidak akan bisa mendapatkan EXP melalui misi jika sudah mencapai level maksimum. Jika kondisi khusus menyebabkan Trailblazer melakukan pembelian "Nameless Glory" atau "Nameless Medal" secara berulang, "The Nameless EXP" tidak akan bertambah dan Trailblazer akan mendapatkan pengembalian Oneiric Shard sebesar nilai pembelian Oneiric Shard ×750 atau nilai pembelian Oneiric Shard ×1.410. Jika kondisi khusus menyebabkan Trailblazer melakukan pembelian "Honor Badge" secara berulang, Trailblazer akan mendapatkan pengembalian Oneiric Shard sebesar nilai pembelian Oneiric Shard ×860. Pada 2026/08/24 02:59:00 , pembelian "Nameless Glory", "Nameless Medal", dan "Honor Badge" untuk periode event kali ini akan ditutup. Setelah pembelian ditutup, Trailblazer masih bisa menyelesaikan misi Kehormatan Tanpa Nama dan mengambil hadiah. Harap Trailblazer perhatikan waktu pembelian dan durasi event. Waktu pembelian item "Nameless Glory", "Nameless Medal" dan "Honor Badge" di pusat top-up web akan berakhir pada 2026/08/23 03:59:00 . Harap Trailblazer yang menggunakan top-up web perhatikan waktu pembelian.

title.en: Version 4.4 "In Ravages Does the Whistle Sound" Update Details
title.id: Penjelasan Update Versi 4.4 "Gema Peluit di Ambang Kesunyian"

desc.en: The Navigator charts a course to the apocalypse. A mournful whistle howls, and only those of the Trailblaze can find a path to survival across the realm of death... Dear Trailblazers, Welcome to Version 4.4 "In Ravages Does the Whistle Sound"! Update and Compensation Details Version 4.4 will run from after the Version 4.4 update until 2026/08/26 06:00:00 . ■ Update Time Begins at 2026/07/15 06:00:00 . The update will take approximately 5 hours. ■ Compensation Details Server Maintenance Compensation Compensation: Stellar Jade ×300 Eligible Recipients: Trailblazers with Trailblaze Level ≥ 4 before 2026/07/15 06:00:00 ※ Please claim before the end of Version 4.4. Bug Compensation Compensation: Stellar Jade ×300 Eligible Recipients: Trailblazers with Trailblaze Level ≥ 4 before 2026/07/15 06:00:00 ※ Please log in to claim the mail before 2026/08/14 23:59:00 . The Crew will issue the compensation via in-game mail to Trailblazers within 5 hours after the update is complete. Be sure to claim it in time. ■ How to Update PC: Exit the game, restart the launcher, then click "Update" Android: Enter the game and follow the instructions in the in-game pop-up window to complete the update iOS: Enter the App Store and tap "Update" PS5®: After entering the game, the game will automatically download and install the update Version Update Details 1. New Story ■ Trailblaze Mission "Planarcadia - In Ravages Does the Whistle Sound" The Navigator charts a course to the apocalypse. A mournful whistle howls, and only those of the Trailblaze can find a path to survival across the realm of death... Availability: Permanently available after the Version 4.4 update Requirement: Trailblaze Level ≥ 21 ※ During Version 4.4, this content can be experienced in advance through the Finality's Vision function. ※ It is recommended that Trailblazers complete the Trailblaze Mission "Planarcadia — The Lethe Below the Living" before experiencing this content. ■ Trailblaze Continuance "Planarcadia — Imagenae: Holy Grail War" A golden rain falls. A Holy Grail, stolen. Somewhere in the shadows beyond the Phantasmoon's reach, you'll step onto the battlefield of the Imagenae Holy Grail War, accompanied by Rin Tohsaka, a mage from another world... Availability: Long-term available after 2026/07/24 12:00:00 Requirement: Trailblaze Level ≥ 3 ※ Trailblaze Continuance "Imagenae: Holy Grail War" can be experienced in advance through the Finality's Vision function. ※ It is recommended that Trailblazers complete the Trailblaze Mission "Planarcadia — So Laughed the Masses" before experiencing this content. ※ This collaboration event "Fate/Star Rail Night" will unfold as the story progresses. 2. New Characters ■ 5-Star Himeko • Nova (Erudition: Fire) Himeko • Nova is a damage-dealing character who can pilot a mech and provide support attacks. While Himeko • Nova is on the field, all allies can call the mech to launch support attacks. After using her Ultimate, the mech will launch multiple powerful attacks against all enemies. During exploration, Himeko • Nova can also pilot the mech to directly defeat encountered enemies. ■ 5-Star Rin Tohsaka (Erudition: Quantum) Rin Tohsaka is a damage-dealing character who uses "Gem Energy" to enhance her Skill Burst. Whenever teammates consume or recover Skill Points, Rin Tohsaka gains "Gem Energy" and her CRIT DMG increases. When using her Enhanced Skill, the more "Gem Energy" consumed, the higher the DMG dealt to enemies. Additionally, when on the same team as Archer, she can also trigger a Joint Follow-Up ATK. ■ 5-Star Gilgamesh (Destruction: Lightning) Gilgamesh is a damage-dealing character driven by "Interest" who relies on his Ultimate to deal burst DMG. Teammates' actions can accumulate "Interest" for him, provide Energy, and increase Ultimate DMG. As his "Interest" increases, he can take action more quickly and launch frequent attacks. Additionally, he can also trigger a Joint Follow-Up ATK when Saber is on the same team. ※ Note: Collaboration characters do not have English voiceovers. You may switch to another voiceover language. Rin Tohsaka voice artist (Japanese: Kana Ueda; Chinese: 朔小兔; Korean: 김보민); Gilgamesh voice artist (Japanese: Tomokazu Seki; Chinese: 藤新; Korean: 김종엽). ※ Without changing your audio language in Settings, Trailblazers can individually switch collaboration characters' interaction, combat, and idle voice lines to the Fate[UBW] original audio (Japanese) via Character Details > Information > Voice. 3. New Light Cones ■ 5-Star A Star That Lights the Night (Erudition) Obtainable through the "Brilliant Fixation: A Star That Lights the Night" Light Cone Event Warp. ■ 5-Star Flickering Stars (Erudition) Obtainable through the "Kaleidic Coruscation" Fate[UBW] Light Cone Collaboration Warp. ■ 5-Star I Am As You Behold (Destruction) Obtainable from the "Age of Gods Golden Gate" Fate[UBW] Light Cone Collaboration Warp. 4. New Outfits ■ Outfit "Candy-Coated Waves" Outfit for Sparxie (Elation: Fire). After Version 4.4 update, the Candy-Coated Waves outfit will be available in the Outfit Show Window and temporarily sold at 1,350 Oneiric Shards. After the event ends, this outfit will revert to the original price of 1,680 Oneiric Shards. Discount Period: During Version 4.4 ■ Trailblaze Fashion "Fan-Made Lygus" Can be exchanged in the "Gift of Stardust" section of the Store using Lone Stardust. 5. New Areas ■ Desolate Maw's Demonhold A "miracle" forged by Asat Pramad. Planarcadia, poised on the brink of destruction, contorts like a scrambled puzzle cube, while an ancient behemoth lurks at the bottom of the abyss, poised to savor this long-overdue feast. ■ Fallen Star's Cradle Where the Tower of Infinity fell, where the Tower of Infinity slumbers, where the Tower of Infinity departs. 6. New Events ■ Antigraft Brickbuster No corner stays dust-free forever. At Aventurine's request, you launched an investigation into IPC corruption by hacking into their database. Event Period: After the Version 4.4 update – 2026/08/26 03:59:00 Requirement: Trailblaze Level ≥ 21 ※ This content can be experienced in advance through the Finality's Vision function. ※ It is recommended that Trailblazers complete the Trailblaze Missions "Penacony — Stranger in a Strange Land" and "Planarcadia — Real Holy Laughter!" before experiencing this content. ■ Fate/Star Rail Night A golden rain falls. A Holy Grail, stolen. Somewhere in the shadows beyond the Phantasmoon's reach, a certain king's treasury has unexpectedly shattered into shambles. To prevent chaos, you'll have no choice but to team up with Rin Tohsaka, a mage from another world, to restore order, and while you're at it, to claim your own share of the treasure. Event Period: 2026/07/24 12:00:00 - 2026/08/26 03:59:00 Requirement: Trailblaze Level ≥ 3 ※ This content can be experienced in advance through the Finality's Vision function. ※ It is recommended that Trailblazers complete the Trailblaze Mission "Planarcadia — So Laughed the Masses" before experiencing this content. ■ Fate Contract: Renewal During the event, log in to the game to claim the limited 5-star collaboration character Gilgamesh (Destruction: Lightning) ×1 or Archer (The Hunt: Quantum) ×1 and materials to build him to Lv. 60. Event Period: 2026/07/24 12:00:00 — Before the end of Version 4.6 Requirement: Trailblaze Level ≥ 3 ■ Fate Gift During the event, Trailblazers who spend a total of 200 Star Rail Special Passes in any Version 4.4 Warp event can claim the limited 5-Star collaboration Light Cone I Am As You Behold (Destruction) ×1 or The Hell Where Ideals Burn (The Hunt) ×1 after the Collaboration Warp updates on 2026/07/24 12:00:00 . All Warp events in Version 4.4 share the accumulated total of Star Rail Special Pass uses. Event Period: 2026/07/24 12:00:00 – 2026/08/26 06:00:00 Requirement: Unlock Warp Function ■ Gift of Odyssey Log in every day during the event to obtain check-in rewards. Trailblazers can claim Star Rail Special Pass ×10 after checking in for 7 days! ※ Please refer to future announcements for information on other events. 7. Others ■ Enemies "Lord of Saṃvartasthāyi, Asat Pramad," "Comediologist" ■ Gameplay Anomaly Arbitration's high-difficulty game mode will be updated with the coming version, and players can play it to earn rewards including Lone Stardust, Interference Keys, Self-Modeling Resin, and limited-time avatar frames. This Period's Theme: "Anomaly Arbitration: Enwreathed by the World" Treasures Lightward: Regular game modes Apocalyptic Shadow, Pure Fiction, and Forgotten Hall: Memory of Chaos will be refreshed alternately. For more details, please see below: Apocalyptic Shadow: Vanguard Knight 2026/07/20 04:00:00 – 2026/08/31 03:59:00 When an enemy unit with Steadfast Safeguard is Weakness Broken, dispel control debuff for all allies, recover their Skill Points, and activate their Ultimates. Increases the Skill DMG taken by all enemies by 25% and increases Ultimate DMG taken by 15%. Pure Fiction: Fabricated Business 2026/08/03 04:00:00 – 2026/09/14 03:59:00 After ally targets use a Follow-Up ATK to attack enemy targets, every enemy target hit additionally accumulates 8 Grit Value for allies. Memory of Chaos: Stormcleanse 2026/08/17 04:00:00 - 2026/09/28 06:00:00 At the start of each Cycle, randomly causes 1 ally target following the Path of The Hunt or Erudition to immediately take action and increases their DMG dealt by 80% for 1 turn. ※ This period of "Memory of Chaos: Stormcleanse" will last until 2026/09/28 06:00:00 . Please check the Version 4.5 update announcement for more information. ■ Stages "Echo of War: The Comedy of Doom," "Divergent Universe: Bugs Incoming" ■ Relics Planar Ornament "Fallen Star Anchorage" Planar Ornament "Cosmic Life Sciences Institute" ■ System Adds an Achievement search function and a one-click claim function for Achievement rewards. Adds "Quick Level Up" feature for characters and Light Cones. In the character or Light Cone screen, enable the "Quick Level Up" button to instantly upgrade the current character or Light Cone to the highest possible level. Adds hint information of the current Build Target character's avatar and recommended main stats when viewing Relic Set details on certain interfaces. Adds an outfit illustration display button in "Character — Outfit." Adds a Recommended marker to the "Graphics Quality" settings. Adds hint text and a Recommended marker to the "Display Settings" settings for Android devices. ■ Others New redeemable items have been added to the "Gift of Stardust" store: Pet "Pentaflavor Emoti," Trailblaze Fashion "Fan-Made Lygus," Avatar "Thanks So Much, Meow," Avatar "Where the Will Leads," and Name Card "Soar Beyond." Trailblazers can use Lone Stardust to exchange for rewards in the store. After selecting a Build Target, a Build Target avatar hint will be added to the corresponding required upgrade materials in the Embers Exchange store. Adds a hint for when a Message conversation ends. Adds new content such as Furbobocom, readable items, messages, disks, room decorations, achievements, data bank entries, and loading screen texts. They will be gradually unlocked during your Trailblaze Progress. Adjustments and Optimizations ■ Characters and Enemies Adjusts the Skill button trigger range for the character Mortenax Blade (Nihility: Fire). After the adjustment, the trigger range will correspond to the button's actual UI display. ■ Missions Starting from Version 4.4, some Trailblaze Missions and Trailblaze Continuance can be unlocked and experienced in advance using Finality's Vision during the current version. Adjusts and optimizes certain interactions and hints for the Finality's Vision feature. Adds Act and Chapter information display to some mission-related screens. ■ Gameplay Optimizes the text hints for multiplayer gameplay invitation pop-ups. ■ Events Adjusts the event names "Character Collaboration Warp" and "Light Cone Collaboration Warp" to "Fate[UBW] Character Collaboration Warp" and "Fate[UBW] Light Cone Collaboration Warp." This is just a text change and does not affect the original Warp rules or history records. ■ System Adds a "More Relics" entrance to the Relic information screen of "My Relics" in the Smart Equip feature, allowing for the direct replacement of equipped Relics without prior selection. Additionally, optimizes the sorting logic of the set selection catalog when using Custom Plan. In the Relic Switch screen, Relic information will display the number of affix enhancements by default. In "Relic Recommendation," rarely used sets and main stats will be hidden. Optimizes some of the interactions and display logic when filtering main and subsidiary stats. When enhancing Relics, supports quick switching between Relics equipped on the same character to enhance, reroll, and more. Starting from Version 4.4, Trailblazers no longer need to complete relevant Simulated Universe prerequisite missions, and can obtain Planar Ornaments through the Ornament Extraction feature simply by unlocking Planar Ornament. At the same time, optimizes the navigation experience for Planar Ornament Extraction, allowing direct access to the corresponding stage screens without needing to teleport. Memperbaiki masalah pada sebagian efek khusus dari area pembatas Karakter "Mortenax Blade (Nihility: Fire)" yang tampil secara abnormal di latar tempat pertempuran tertentu. Memperbaiki masalah layar tersendat yang terjadi pada kondisi tertentu saat menekan tombol kemampuan berturut-turut, ketika beberapa karakter melancarkan kemampuan tertentu dalam pertempuran. Memperbaiki masalah di mana pada kondisi tertentu, tampilan UI efek "Blessing of the Lake" dari karakter "Saber (Destruction: Wind)" tidak sesuai dengan poin Energy yang sebenarnya terkumpul. Masalah ini tidak memengaruhi efek sebenarnya. Memperbaiki masalah di mana pada kondisi tertentu, selama area pembatas karakter "Mortenax Blade (Nihility: Fire)" berlangsung, saat target musuh memasuki tahap berikutnya atau dibangkitkan, status "Balefire Bind" berpeluang menjadi abnormal. Memperbaiki masalah di mana pada kondisi tertentu, teks DMG yang muncul menjadi abnormal setelah unit rekan tim atau musuh yang memiliki Shield terkena serangan dalam pertempuran. Memperbaiki masalah pada sebagian tampilan UI yang abnormal setelah status "Morbid Dream" dihapus dari karakter tertentu dalam pertempuran melawan musuh "Memory Zone Meme 'Something Unto Death'". Memperbaiki masalah di mana dalam pertempuran melawan musuh "Phantylia the Undying", saat target musuh memasuki tahap berikutnya, pada kondisi tertentu karakter tidak dapat melakukan aksi dan sebagian UI tombol menghilang secara abnormal. Memperbaiki masalah dalam pertempuran dengan musuh "Sublime, Radiant, Avatar of the Sky" dan "Decimator, Karma of Daythunder, Eye of Twilight", di mana pada kondisi tertentu, efek negatif yang diberikan oleh beberapa karakter kepada target musuh menjadi tidak normal. ■ Misi Memperbaiki masalah di mana pada kondisi tertentu, sebagian NPC ditampilkan secara abnormal dalam proses Misi Trailblaze "Planarcadia" - "Zaman Purba dan Zaman Lainnya". Memperbaiki masalah dalam proses Misi Trailblaze "Planarcadia" - "Zaman Purba dan Zaman Lainnya", di mana saat terjadi fluktuasi jaringan, melakukan tindakan tertentu memiliki peluang menyebabkan tampilan sebagian dialog menjadi abnormal. ■ Sistem Memperbaiki masalah di mana pada kondisi tertentu, pemain tidak dapat keluar dari "Pandangan Finality" saat memainkan sebagian konten melalui "Pandangan Finality". ■ Gameplay Memperbaiki masalah ketidaknormalan sebagian efek Persamaan "Ironarm Ranger" yang dalam kondisi tertentu terjadi di "Divergent Universe: Catatan Perjalanan Utopia". Memperbaiki masalah pada "Divergent Universe: Catatan Perjalanan Utopia", di mana dalam kondisi tertentu, Gaya Perintis "Api Karma Seberang" yang dikenakan menghilang secara abnormal. Memperbaiki masalah pada "Divergent Universe: Tantangan Daya Tembak" di mana setelah melakukan operasi tertentu, tampilan model Bro Hanu menjadi abnormal. Memperbaiki masalah pada kondisi tertentu, di mana interaksi menjadi abnormal setelah keluar dari "Jump 2D!" dan kembali ke antarmuka utama. ■ Latar Tempat Memperbaiki masalah di mana pada kondisi tertentu, beberapa foto dari Misi Trailblaze "Stasiun Luar Angkasa 'Herta'" - "Hari Ini Adalah Hari Esoknya Kemarin" di "Lemari Pajangan Koleksi" - "Dinding Galeri Foto" menghilang. Memperbaiki masalah pada latar tempat "Pertapaan Inkford", di mana pada kondisi tertentu, tampilan pantulan pada sebagian permukaan air terlihat abnormal. ■ Audio Memperbaiki masalah ketidaknormalan sebagian musik dan efek suara dalam kondisi tertentu. Memperbaiki masalah di mana pada kondisi tertentu, latar tempat "Party Car Multipemain" memutar musik latar bawaan secara abnormal. Memperbaiki masalah kesalahan pada sebagian suara dialog dalam progres Misi Trailblaze "Stasiun Luar Angkasa 'Herta'" - "Perjalanan Sedang Berlanjut" saat bahasa pengisi suara yang digunakan adalah Bahasa Jepang. Memperbaiki masalah kesalahan pada sebagian suara dialog dalam progres Misi Trailblaze Lanjutan "Duel Sengit di Atas Langit Biru: Bagian 2" saat menggunakan suara Bahasa Jepang. Memperbaiki masalah kesalahan pada sebagian suara dialog dalam progres Misi Trailblaze "Planarcadia" - "Haru Biru Pemecah Fajar", "Maka, Semua Makhluk Tertawa Tiada Henti", dan "Terbenam di Sungai Kelupaan Milik Kehidupan" saat menggunakan suara Bahasa Jepang. ■ Lainnya Memperbaiki masalah ketidaknormalan sebagian tampilan UI dalam game. Memperbaiki masalah ketidaknormalan pada beberapa interaksi dalam kondisi tertentu saat bermain game menggunakan controller. Memperbaiki masalah di mana pada kondisi tertentu, Achievement "Protektif" dan "Tiga Menjadi Satu" tidak dapat diselesaikan. Memperbaiki masalah kesalahan pada sebagian deskripsi entri "Tutorial" untuk "Alloy Mechatron: King Pom-Pom". Setelah perbaikan, deskripsi akan sama dengan efek yang sebenarnya. Memperbaiki masalah di mana pada kondisi tertentu, "Level Equilibrium" dari entri "Tutorial" tidak terbuka secara normal. Setelah perbaikan, entri yang sesuai akan secara otomatis terbuka untuk Trailblazer yang memenuhi syarat pembukaannya. Memperbaiki masalah pada "Berita Rakun" di mana beberapa avatar netizen keliru. Memperbaiki masalah ekspresi abnormal pada Peliharaan "Tim Reporter Rakun" saat menggunakan perangkat tertentu. Memperbaiki masalah di mana pada kondisi tertentu, saat menggunakan fitur Kamera dan menyembunyikan peliharaan, sebagian efek khusus dari peliharaan "Tim Reporter Rakun" ditampilkan secara abnormal. title.en: Version 4.4 New Stages
title.id: Stage Baru Versi 4.4

desc.en: Dear Trailblazers, After the Version 4.4 update, the new stages Echo of War: The Comedy of Doom and Divergent Universe: Bugs Incoming will be added. Echo of War: The Comedy of Doom Successfully challenge the stage to obtain the new Trace Material "High Hopes of the Falsely Enlightened," Relics "Ever-Glorious Magical Girl" and "Self-Enshrouded Recluse," the item "Lucent Afterglow," Light Cones "Mushy Shroomy's Adventures" and "Victory In a Blink," and more. Planar Ornament Extraction ■ Divergent Universe: Bugs Incoming Successfully challenge the stage "Divergent Universe: Bugs Incoming," and Trailblazers can use Trailblaze Power, Immersifiers, or Deep Immersifiers to obtain the brand-new Planar Ornaments Fallen Star Anchorage and Cosmic Life Sciences Institute via "Planar Ornament Extraction." New Planar Ornament Effects Preview: Fallen Star Anchorage Link Rope: Silver Rails of the Anchorage Planar Sphere: Stranded Express at the Anchorage 2-Pc: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by 8%. When entering combat, if the wearer and another teammate are both Trailblaze Companions characters, increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by 32%. Cosmic Life Sciences Institute Link Rope: Peripheral Conduits of the Life Sciences Institute Planar Sphere: Central Synapse of the Life Sciences Institute 2-Pc: When entering combat, if the wearer's Max Energy is greater than or equal to 200, increases the wearer's DMG dealt by 0.2% for every 1 point exceeding this value, up to a max increase of 32%.
desc.id: Dear Trailblazer, Setelah update Versi 4.4, stage baru "Echo of War: The Comedy of Doom" dan "Divergent Universe: Serangan Serangga" akan ditambahkan. Echo of War: The Comedy of Doom Selesaikan tantangan stage untuk memperoleh Material Trace baru "High Hopes of the Falsely Enlightened", Relic "Ever-Glorious Magical Girl" dan "Self-Enshrouded Recluse", item "Lucent Afterglow", Light Cone "Mushy Shroomy's Adventures" dan "Victory In a Blink", dll. Ekstraksi Ornament ■ Divergent Universe: Serangan Serangga Setelah berhasil menantang stage "Divergent Universe: Serangan Serangga", Trailblazer dapat menggunakan Trailblaze Power, Immersifier atau Deep Immersifier di "Ekstraksi Planar Ornament" untuk memperoleh Planar Ornament baru "Fallen Star Anchorage" dan "Cosmic Life Sciences Institute". Preview Efek Planar Ornament Baru: "Fallen Star Anchorage" Link Rope - Silver Rails of the Anchorage Planar Sphere - Stranded Express at the Anchorage Set 2 Bagian: Meningkatkan 8% CRIT Rate pengguna. Saat memasuki pertempuran, CRIT DMG pengguna meningkat 32% jika pengguna dan satu rekan lainnya sama-sama karakter Rekan Perintisan. "Cosmic Life Sciences Institute" Link Rope - Peripheral Conduits of the Life Sciences Institute Planar Sphere - Central Synapse of the Life Sciences Institute Set 2 bagian: Saat memasuki pertempuran, jika Max Energy pengguna lebih dari atau sama dengan 200 poin, setiap 1 poin yang berlebih akan meningkatkan 0,2% DMG yang diakibatkan pengguna, maksimal meningkat 32%.

title.en: Known Issues & Game Optimizations
title.id: Penjelasan Optimalisasi Game dan Masalah yang Sudah Teridentifikasi

subtitle.id: Penjelasan Optimalisasi Game dan Masalah yang Sudah Teridentifikasi

desc.en: Dear Proxies, To reduce the impact brought about by abnormal Hollow fluctuations and ensure Proxies can live happily in New Eridu, we will make sure to take everyone's feedback into account and promptly address any issues that arise. [Known Issues] August 18 • There is a known issue where the acquisition description for the items "[Blueprint] Bangboo Big Inventory," "[Blueprint] High-Grade Blade of the Other: Rush," "[Blueprint] High-Grade Blade of the Other: Powerslash," "[Blueprint] High-Grade Blade of the Other: Block," and "[Blueprint] High-Grade Anti-Corruption Device" in Enigma of the Labyrinth: Operation Bagel incorrectly states that they can be obtained via direct purchase at the Store. This issue will be fixed in a future update. August 17 • There is a known issue where, under certain circumstances, when the enemy Ye Shiyuan the Thrall is Stunned and hit by certain skills, the resulting Stun DMG Multiplier may be abnormal. This issue will be fixed in a future update. August 4 • There is a known issue that some Proxies playing on PlayStation®5 may experience extended loading times when entering the game for the first time. This issue only occurs after downloading an update and entering the game for the first time. Proxies can resolve this by restarting the game after the update is complete. July 29 • There is a known issue that may prevent the sharing of content to X (Twitter). This issue is expected to be fixed in a future update. • There is a known issue where, after the Version 3.1 update, some Proxies' participation in Notorious Hunt stages may not have been counted correctly toward the new version's New Eridu City Fund Expansion Tasks progress. If any Proxies have encountered this issue, completing a Notorious Hunt stage again this week will tally your progress correctly. • There is a known issue where Sony Xperia 1 VIII, Sony Xperia 1 VII, and subsequent Sony devices equipped with Snapdragon 8 Elite or 5th Gen Snapdragon 8 Elite processors may experience intermittent lag and stuttering that disrupt normal gameplay. Proxies are advised to switch to a different device to experience the game. • When the NVIDIA graphics card driver version on your PC: i. Is lower than 591.74 (Jan 2026), enabling DX12 mode may cause UI or scene texture display anomalies or crashes. Proxies are advised to update their NVIDIA graphics card drivers before enabling DX12 mode. ii. On Windows 10 in DX12 mode, launching OBS with the source set to [Game Capture] may cause the game to crash. If Proxies run into this issue, just close OBS before starting the game, and you should be good to go. [Issue Fixes & Optimizations Summary] August 18 Update Details • Fixes an issue where, under certain circumstances, after obtaining and using certain Access Cards in Enigma of the Labyrinth: Operation Bagel, they were not properly recorded in the database. • Fixes an issue where, under certain circumstances, selecting an item will cause the item details to display abnormally while experiencing Enigma of the Labyrinth: Operation Bagel with a controller. • Fixes an issue where the target marker would be in an incorrect position when tracking the "Eous is safe at last. Talk to him." commission in Enigma of the Labyrinth: Operation Bagel under certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue where the NPC Boorilliant's model appears abnormally under certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue where Agent Sigrid's portrait and model would be displayed abnormally under certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue where, under certain circumstances, the detail interface would switch abnormally when viewing item details in Enigma of the Labyrinth: Operation Bagel. • Fixes an issue where the hound Ulidim would no longer appear after using an elevator in Enigma of the Labyrinth: Operation Bagel under certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue where, under certain circumstances, the game screen would abnormally go black after entering a designated stage during the "Return to the Papago Hollow to investigate" commission in Enigma of the Labyrinth: Operation Bagel. • Fixes an issue in certain areas of the Enigma of the Labyrinth: Operation Bagel gameplay where the same enemy could abnormally respawn repeatedly under certain circumstances. • Fixes part of the skill description for Agent Sigrid's Core Passive: Sky Knight. This fix only affects the text description, and the actual effect remains unchanged. • Fixes an issue where, under certain circumstances, Agent Sigrid could abnormally perform a character switch while the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear was triggered, which had a chance of causing the game to freeze • In-game text adjustments, improvements, and fixes for some languages. These changes will not affect gameplay. August 12 Update Details • Optimizes the encounter rate of Miasmic - Starlight - Billy in the Lower-Level Elevator of Suburbs Illusion in the Hard and High-Risk difficulty of Enigma of the Labyrinth: Operation Bagel. • Fixes an issue in Enigma of the Labyrinth: Operation Bagel where the consumption priority of the shield generated by Etheric Phantom: Sobek was abnormal. • Fixes an issue in Enigma of the Labyrinth: Operation Bagel where sharing the successful evacuation message to group channels would result in the Gear Coin icon being displayed abnormally. • Fixes an issue in Enigma of the Labyrinth: Operation Bagel, where players could be abnormally hit by enemy attacks when teleporting through a fissure or evacuating under certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue in Enigma of the Labyrinth: Operation Bagel, where the quantity of Gear Coins consumed in restocking and crafting items in the Smart Workshop is incorrect under certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue in Enigma of the Labyrinth: Operation Bagel, where interactions with some containers are anomalous under certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue in Enigma of the Labyrinth: Operation Bagel, where the Agent Health display is abnormal after handling the "Enter the fissure and search for Eous" commission under certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue where the control interface would behave abnormally after entering the Hound Domain in Enigma of the Labyrinth: Operation Bagel under certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue where certain containers in Enigma of the Labyrinth: Operation Bagel had abnormal corruption states under certain circumstances. • Fixes certain reward description issues in the Fool in a Barrel interface of Enigma of the Labyrinth: Operation Bagel under certain circumstances. • desc.id: Dear Proxy: Demi mengurangi dampak dari fluktuasi anomali Hollow, kami akan memastikan untuk selalu mendengarkan masukan dari kalian. Kami juga akan merespons dan menangani berbagai masalah yang teridentifikasi dengan cepat untuk memastikan kehidupan sehari-hari kalian di New Eridu berjalan lancar. [Masalah yang Sudah Teridentifikasi] 18 Agustus • Telah teridentifikasi masalah bahwa dalam "Labirin Misterius: Operasi Bagel", teks untuk sumber perolehan item "[Blueprint] Tas Besar Bangboo", "[Blueprint] Belati Varian Tingkat Tinggi - Charge", "[Blueprint] Belati Varian Tingkat Tinggi - Slash", "[Blueprint] Belati Varian Tingkat Tinggi - Parry", dan "[Blueprint] Anti-Corrosion Device Tingkat Tinggi" secara keliru memiliki opsi tambahan "Dapat dibeli melalui Penjualan Langsung Blueprint". Masalah ini akan diperbaiki dalam update mendatang. 17 Agustus • Telah teridentifikasi masalah pada Kelipatan Stun DMG yang diakibatkan dari sebagian Skill saat mengenai musuh Ye Shiyuan the Thrall yang berada dalam status Stun pada kondisi tertentu. Masalah ini akan diperbaiki dalam update mendatang. 4 Agustus • Telah teridentifikasi masalah pada waktu loading yang terlalu lama saat pertama kali memasuki game bagi sebagian Proxy yang bermain menggunakan perangkat PlayStation®5. Masalah ini hanya terjadi setelah mengunduh pembaruan dan memasuki game untuk pertama kalinya. Proxy dapat mengatasi masalah ini dengan memulai ulang game setelah selesai mengunduh pembaruan. 29 Juli • Telah teridentifikasi masalah di mana konten kemungkinan tidak dapat dibagikan ke X. Masalah ini diperkirakan akan diperbaiki pada update mendatang. • Telah teridentifikasi bahwa setelah update versi 3.1, untuk sebagian Proxy yang telah berpartisipasi dalam "Perburuan Keji", terdapat masalah yang menyebabkan progres Misi Ekspansi "Dana Kota New Eridu" versi baru tidak terhitung dengan benar. Jika Proxy mengalami masalah ini, silakan selesaikan "Perburuan Keji" sekali lagi dalam minggu ini agar progres dapat terhitung dengan benar. • Diketahui bahwa perangkat Sony Xperia 1 VIII, Sony Xperia 1 VII, serta perangkat Sony seri berikutnya yang menggunakan Snapdragon 8 Elite dan Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 saat ini mengalami masalah lag dan stuttering yang dapat menyebabkan game tidak berjalan dengan normal. Proxy disarankan menggunakan perangkat lain untuk pengalaman bermain yang lebih baik. • Saat memeriksa versi driver kartu grafis Nvidia di PC: 1. Jika versi di bawah 591.74 (2026.01), mengaktifkan mode DX12 mungkin akan membuat tampilan UI atau tekstur lingkungan menjadi tidak normal atau mengakibatkan game mengalami crash. Harap Proxy memperbarui driver kartu grafis NVIDIA sebelum mengaktifkan mode DX12. 2. Pada sistem Win10, mengaktifkan mode DX12 saat menjalankan OBS dengan source mode "Game Capture" kemungkinan dapat menyebabkan crash. Jika Proxy mengalami masalah ini, silakan tutup software perekam OBS terlebih dahulu, lalu jalankan game kembali. desc.en: Dear Proxies, Below is the updated content and compensation for Version 3.1 "The Long Goodbye." [Update Start Time] 2026/07/29 06:00 (UTC+8) It will take about five hours to complete. [Compensation Details] • Server Update Compensation Compensation: Polychrome ×300 Requirements: Reach Inter-Knot Lv. 4 before 2026/07/29 06:00 (UTC+8) . ※ Can be claimed until the end of Version 3.1. Please note that Version 3.1 will run for 42 days, ending on 2026/09/09 06:00 (UTC+8) . • Issue Fix Compensation Compensation: Polychrome ×300 Requirements: Reach Inter-Knot Lv. 4 before 2026/07/29 06:00 (UTC+8) . Please log in to the game and claim the compensation before 2026/08/28 23:59 (UTC+8) . The dev team will issue the compensation via in-game mail after the update has been completed. The mail will expire after 30 days, so don't forget to claim the attachments. [How to Update] • PC Exit the game, restart, then select update. • Android After entering the game, follow the in-game pop-up instructions to complete the update. • iOS Go to the App Store and select update. • PS5™ or PS5™ Pro Open the PS5 home screen > Highlight Zenless Zone Zero > Hold down the Options button on your controller > Check for updates. • Xbox Series X|S Open your Xbox dashboard > My games & apps > Manage > Select Zenless Zone Zero on the Updates page and confirm the update. [New Content] 1. New Agents • S-Rank Agent Remielle (Lumiflux - Anomaly) Can be obtained through the "Paradise Regained" Signal Search. • S-Rank Agent Sigrid (Ice - Attack) Can be obtained through the "'Till the Ends of the Sky" Signal Search. 2. New W-Engines • S-Rank W-Engine Ode of Resurrected Wings (Anomaly) Can be obtained through the "Ode of Resurrected Wings" Signal Search. • S-Rank W-Engine Knight's Extolment (Attack) Can be obtained through "Knight's Extolment" Signal Search. 3. New Bangboo • S-Rank Bangboo Ariel Can be obtained through the "An Outstanding Partner" Signal Search. 4. New Story • Main Story Season 3 Chapter 2 "The Long Goodbye" Fate plucks the strings. Is this the prelude to tomorrow, or the finale of farewell? Availability: Permanently available after the Version 3.1 update Requirements: Complete Main Story Season 3 Chapter 1 "A Sleepwalker's Confession" ※ You can experience Season 3's content in advance via the Advance Screening function after ranking up in Season 1 Chapter 1 - Intermission. • Agent Trust Events, Quality Time Events New Agent Trust Events and Quality Time Events for Remielle and Sigrid. Availability: Permanently available after the Version 3.1 update How to Unlock: Obtain the corresponding Agents and complete the required Stories (Please see Workbench > Partner Archive) 5. New Area • Adds a new area: Roscaelifer - Booastrum - Gear Street Requirements: Available after the Version 3.1 update and after unlocking the Booastrum district. 6. New Outfits • Remielle: Seashade Pas Seul This was originally a solo dance, yet a ray of light has illuminated the secrecy and solitude shrouded in darkness. Now, would you care to join me for a pas de deux, my partner in crime? ※ After the Version 3.1 update – 2026/09/09 05:59 (UTC+8), Remielle's Seashade Pas Seul outfit will be on sale at a limited-time discount in Store - Today's Outfit. During the discount period, the price is Monochrome ×1,350. After the discount period ends, the price will revert to Monochrome ×1,680. Limited to one purchase during the sale period. • Remielle: Moonlight Whispers Since the sun has never shown mercy, let us embrace the fall alongside the moonlit night. You say it's difficult to differentiate between jokes and deception? Then let's have another round of our Q&A game, my dear partner in crime. ※ Upon obtaining the Moonlight Whispers outfit, Proxies will also receive the Moonlight Whispers (Veil) outfit and can freely switch between the two. The only difference between the two outfits is whether the veil is worn or not. ※ After the Version 3.1 update – 2026/09/09 05:59 (UTC+8), Remielle's Moonlight Whispers outfit will be on sale at a limited-time discount in Store - Today's Outfit. During the discount period, the price is Monochrome ×1,350. After the discount period ends, the price will revert to Monochrome ×1,680. Limited to one purchase during the sale period. ※ From after the Version 3.1 update – 2026/09/09 05:59 (UTC+8), the outfit bundle "Moonlit Shore" will be available for a limited time in the Shop. The bundle includes Remielle's outfits Seashade Pas Seul and Moonlight Whispers, and will be available with a limited-time discount of 30%, at a price of Monochrome ×2,350. ※ Outfit bundle deals and individual item discounts are separate promotions and cannot be stacked. • Sigrid: Majestic Wavechaser A knight accustomed to galloping through the skies must now face a new challenge from the waves and the sun! ※ From 2026/08/19 12:00 (server time) – 2026/09/09 05:59 (UTC+8), Sigrid's Majestic Wavechaser outfit will be on sale at a limited-time discount in Store - Today's Outfit. During the discount period, the price is Monochrome ×1,350. After the discount period ends, the price will revert to Monochrome ×1,680. Limited to one purchase during the sale period. • Lucy: Princess on Holiday A baseball bat obviously has no place in beach volleyball, but it can ensure no one disturbs the princess of the wildlands' holiday fun. Grassy, Woody, Bricky — time to enter vacation combat mode! ※ Participate in the limited-time event "Summer Waves Roll In" to obtain Lucy's new outfit, Princess on Holiday. 7. New Events • Marcel Anniversary Gift Claim a limited S-Rank Agent, S-Rank W-Engine, loads of Polychromes, and other rewards! —A most sincere greeting. Good morning, good afternoon, and good night. Event Duration: After the Version 3.1 update – End of Version 3.1 Requirements: Reach Inter-Knot Lv. 5, complete the Main Story Prologue "The Hare and the Proxy," and unlock the Event feature • Phaethon's Grand Reveal of the Year After working on this legendary story for another year, it's time to look through it again carefully. The "Grand Reveal of the Year" Special Program starts now! Event Duration: After the Version 3.1 update – End of Version 3.1 Requirements: Reach Inter-Knot Lv. 20 and complete Main Story Chapter 1 - Intermission to participate • Potential Hypothesis: Hunting Game Is toying with your prey a bad habit that should be admonished? As long as you're willing, your old friends would be more than happy to indulge you in a new hunting game. Event Duration: After the Version 3.1 update – End of Version 3.1 Requirements: Unlock Ridu Weekly in Main Story Chapter 1 to participate • Gift From the Clouds During the event, log in for a total of 7 days to obtain Encrypted Master Tape ×10! —The city above the clouds is waiting for your arrival. Event Duration: After the Version 3.1 update – 2026/09/08 03:59 (server time) Requirements: Reach Inter-Knot Lv. 5, complete the Main Story Prologue "The Hare and the Proxy," and unlock the Event feature • Summer Waves Roll In The one who comes chasing the tides all the way from the skies will naturally receive the sea's blessings. Under the glow of the bonfire lies the reflection of an unforgettable summer adventure. Event Duration: After the Version 3.1 update – 2026/09/07 03:59 (server time) Requirements: Reach Inter-Knot Lv. 20 and complete Main Story Chapter 1 - Intermission to participate • Snap! Focus Showdown! On the sides of the lens are the embers of daily life and the blaze of battle! The moment you press the shutter, the two flames intertwine! Event Duration: 2026/08/07 10:00 (server time) – 2026/08/24 03:59 (server time) Requirements: Reach Inter-Knot Lv. 20 and complete Main Story Chapter 1 - Intermission to participate • Return to Ridu: Feathers of Reunion Invite friends to return or register for the game and earn up to Polychrome ×340! Join the lucky draw for a chance to win a mobile phone, game console, merch, and Polychromes. Event Period: 2026/07/17 20:30 (UTC+8) – 2026/09/09 05:59 (UTC+8) • Extensive Patrol: Triple Bounty During the event, Area Patrol rewards will be tripled! "The Hollow lies ahead, and the situation is dire... The Defense Force is eager to fight alongside you." Event Duration: 2026/08/12 04:00 (server time) – 2026/08/17 03:59 (server time) Requirements: Reach Inter-Knot Lv. 21, complete the Reputation Rank-Up Mission "Path of the Proxy I," and unlock Area Patrol to participate • The Great En-Nah Giveaway! Log in for a total of 7 days to obtain Encrypted Master Tape ×10 and Boopon ×10! "En-nah~ En-neh? (Are you ready for Roscaelifer's biggest and bestest giveaway yet?)" Event Duration: 2026/08/19 10:00 (server time) – 2026/09/08 03:59 (server time) Requirements: Reach Inter-Knot Lv. 5, complete the Main Story Prologue "The Hare and the Proxy," and unlock the Event feature • Crispy Meal Deployment Plan With our full sincerity, the best Delusions in business now! The special cuisine operation is a go! See you at Lumina Square, Delulus! Event Duration: 2026/08/19 10:00 (server time) – 2026/09/07 03:59 (server time) Requirements: Reach Inter-Knot Lv. 20 and complete Main Story Chapter 1 - Intermission to participate • Dangerous Fugitive's Leisurely Vacation A first-generation Void Hunter who can't become a wanted fugitive is no good as a photography model— Even if wanted posters are plastered all over Booastrum... strike a pose when the camera catches you! Event Duration: 2026/08/24 10:00 (server time) – 2026/09/07 03:59 (server time) Requirements: Reach Inter-Knot Lv. 20 and complete Main Story Chapter 1 - Intermission to participate • Ding-Dong! Delivery Training in Progress Starlight adorns the letters, miracles entwine with wishes... The Wish Post Office is currently delivering dreams. First come, first served! Event Duration: 2026/08/28 10:00 (server time) – 2026/09/14 03:59 (server time) Requirements: Reach Inter-Knot Lv. 20 and complete Main Story Chapter 1 - Intermission to participate • Combat Training: Triple Bounty During the event, Combat Simulation rewards will be tripled! "I hear you're preparing for new challenges — need a special training schedule?" Event Duration: 2026/09/02 04:00 (server time) – 2026/09/07 03:59 (server time) Requirements: Unlock Combat Simulation in Main Story Chapter 1 "Cat's Lost & Found" 8. New Gameplay • Enigma of the Labyrinth: Operation Bagel "Enigma of the Labyrinth" is a brand-new permanent game mode introduced in Version 3.1. Proxies need to venture into the depths of the Hollow to collect valuable supplies and evacuate in time. These supplies can be used to build infrastructure to repair the research station, or to craft equipment to boost the Agents' combat capabilities within the Hollow. Venturing into the Hollow to complete item collection, fulfilling commissions, and expanding your catalog will earn you generous Polychromes and other rewards. Complete commissions to redeem Agent Focus: Pyrois and other rewards from the Store. Complete Season Commissions to redeem Twilight Afterimage, new Proxy accessories Belle: Chipi-Meow & Wise: Dubi-Meow, and more. There are also Polychrome rewards up for grabs. Availability: Available after 2026/08/05 10:00 (server time) Requirements: Reach Inter-Knot Lv. 40 9. Other New Content ▶ New Content • After the Version 3.1 update, first-purchase double rewards will be reset in the Monochrome Market for all Monochrome tiers. • After the Version 3.1 update, Vivian's Iris of the Shore outfit will be permanently available in Store - Today's Outfit for Monochrome ×1,680. • Adds the new "Beginner Guide," accessible via the button on the right side of the main interface. Compendium - Primer - Proxy Legend will be moved into this system. The Beginner Guide is divided into two main interfaces: "Enhancement Guide" and "Handbook Missions." Complete the various phases of missions in the Beginner Guide to obtain Polychromes, Master Tapes, Tuning Calibrator, Drive Disc sets, and various upgrade material rewards. ※Adjusted some phase mission rewards for the Proxy Legend missions. If you have already completed the corresponding phase missions of the Proxy Legend trials before Version 3.1, the difference in the Polychrome rewards will be reissued based on the adjusted reward values. Please claim them via in-game mail, Proxies. • Agent Pyrois's detail page will include a new display featuring Wise/Belle. When Wise or Belle's outfit accessories are changed in the city, the Agent detail page will be updated accordingly, and the outfit accessories will also be synced and displayed while in combat with Pyrois. • Adds a function that enables batch locking and unlocking of A-Rank W-Engines in the Storage. Proxies can also set a target max-overclock quantity for each A-Rank W-Engine to remain locked, and any W-Engines exceeding that quantity will be automatically unlocked. • Adds the High-Mobility Enhanced Robot, which can transform into a ball to roll and charge into obstacles during Main Story exploration, and can be used for solving puzzles and clearing paths. • Adds 2 new Side Missions for hidden space exploration. • Adds new areas: Intelligence Shack, Divination Parlor, Cap Shop, Meridian Hall, Core Danger Zone, and Banquet Venue. • Adds the "Swiftspine and Splitclaw" challenge to Area Patrol, where the new Drive Discs, Feathered Fate and Thorned Rose, can be obtained. • Adds the new Light Tuning Test stage to Combat Simulation, where completing the stage grants Specialized Lumiflux Chips, Advanced Lumiflux Chips, and Basic Lumiflux Chips. • Adds new rewards to the Potential Archive store: Reel Projector, Marcato Desire, and Overtimeboo. • New enemies, Girtablullu - Stagnant Aberrant, Infernal Revenant, Ulidim, Integrated - Girtablullu, and Metamorphosed - Hornet have been added. • Adds new achievements related to Phaethon's Story, Agent Trust, When Opportunities Converge, Booastrum, Enigma of the Labyrinth, Combat Techniques, Hostile Targets, and Investigation Zone Adventures, including some hidden achievements. • Adds Adversity Mode to Deadly Assault. This mode will be unlocked after earning 9 Stars in the current season's Trial Mode. Complete Adversity Mode challenges and reach designated scores to earn a limited-time animated avatar, title, namecard, and Investigation Certificates. • The Association Supplies Store now features an Exclusive Showcase, stocked with Remielle's exclusive action, camera frames, Graffiti Marks, as well as emoticons. Spend the corresponding Investigation Certificates to redeem them. • Adds badge sets "Deadly Assault: Purge" and "Deadly Assault: Annihilator" for Deadly Assault's Adversity Mode. • Adds the "Labyrinth Fortune" badge group for "Enigma of the Labyrinth: Operation Bagel." • Adds new titles related to Marcel Anniversary Gift, Agent Trust, Deadly Assault, and Enigma of the Labyrinth. • Dynamic wallpapers for Agents Remielle and Sigrid have been added. Obtain the corresponding Agent and increase your Trust Level to a certain amount to unlock. • Adds Dynamic Wallpaper: Summer of Soda Sea. • Adds the "Options - Graphics - Crowd Density" setting. Proxies can adjust this option to reduce device performance pressure and improve game smoothness. • Adds DX12 support for select AMD graphics cards. Please refer to the official FAQ for details. • Adds dynamic light bar effects for the DualSense wireless controller. • Adds several new menu decoration sets. • Adds several new Proxy accessories. ▶ Shiyu Defense After the Version 3.1 update, the buff effects of Critical Node are as follows: Phase I: • If there are 2/3 Agents with the Anomaly specialty in the squad, Attribute Anomaly DMG dealt by Agents increases by 10%/60%, and the whole squad initially gains 500/1,500 Decibels upon entering combat. • Agent's Ultimate and Chain Attack DMG increase by 40%. When Chain Attack hits an enemy, the enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 20% and their Daze recovery slows down by 15%, lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. • Agent Ice DMG and Electric DMG increase by 30%. After an Attack specialty Agent uses an EX Special Attack, their CRIT DMG increases by 30% for 20s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Phase II: • Attribute Anomaly DMG dealt by Agents increases by 15%. If there are 2/3 Agents in the squad with the Anomaly specialty, Agent Anomaly Proficiency increases by 40/120. • Agent Ether DMG increases by 20%. When an enemy is inflicted with an Attribute Anomaly, their DEF is reduced by 15%, and All-Attribute RES is reduced by 15% for 10s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. • When an Attack Agent lands Basic Attacks on an enemy, they ignore 30% of the enemy's Ice RES. After an Attack Agent uses a Chain Attack or EX Special Attack, their Ice DMG increases by 20%, and CRIT DMG increases by 40% for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Phase III: • Agent Ether DMG and Ice DMG increase by 35%, while their CRIT DMG increases by 25%. When an Attack Agent hits a Stunned enemy, the enemy's DEF decreases by 25% for 5s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. • If there are 2/3 Agents with the Anomaly specialty in the squad, Attribute Anomaly DMG dealt by Agents increases by 10%/60%, and the whole squad initially gains 500/1,500 Decibels upon entering combat. • Agent DEF increases by 15%, and on hit, attacks ignore 20% of the enemy's Electric RES. After an Agent uses an EX Special Attack, their CRIT Rate increases by 5%, and CRIT DMG increases by 20% for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. ▶ Deadly Assault After the Version 3.1 update, the enemies featured in Deadly Assault are as follows: Phase I: Girtablullu - Stagnant Aberrant, Notorious - Dead End Butcher, Unknown Corruption Complex Phase II: Girtablullu - Stagnant Aberrant, Ye Shiyuan the Thrall, Miasma Priest Phase III: Dead End Butcher, Girtablullu, Primordial Nightmare - "The Creator" ▶ Hollow Zero • Adds Tactical Prism Programs for Agents Remielle and Sigrid, along with their corresponding Task Force Missions. Adjustments & Optimizations • Optimizes the auto-selection logic for W-Engines in the Storage panel on the left side of the W-Engine recommendation interface. The corresponding W-Engine with a higher level and overclock phase will now be selected. • Adjusts the EXP required to level up from Level 20 to Level 50, reducing overall leveling time for a smoother progression pace. • Optimizes the control feel and transition timing of some of Agent Rina's skills. • Reduces the ATK of all enemies at different HP thresholds in Deadly Assault's Trial Mode. • Removes the "Events Calendar" entry from the Events tab. Proxies can still view it via the Announcements system. • Adjusts the "Bangbang! The Genius and the Miracle Chip" gameplay: After the Collaboorator reaches max level, the Daily Quests rewards will be updated to Bangboo Module reconstruction items. • Optimizes the display experience of some tips and tags in the "Bangbang! The Genius and the Miracle Chip" gameplay. • Adjusts the crafting of Prepaid Power Cards using "Deep Cleaning" Service Cards to the Outpost Logistics interface. Proxies can now use "Deep Cleaning" Service Cards to exchange for Prepaid Power Cards. • Optimizes the experience of certain red dot notifications in the Compendium. • Optimizes the rules related to the Drive Disc's Smart Discard function. • Optimizes the Teleport location at Booastrum City District - Video Store Branch to prevent accidental activation. • Optimizes some visual effects and art presentation of Booastrum. • Optimizes some visual effects and art presentation of Fantasy Resort. • Adjusts the default graphics quality settings for certain iPhone models (iPhone 12, iPhone 13, etc.). • Fixes some text typos. • Adjusts, improves, and fixes the in-game text for some languages. These changes will not affect gameplay or functions. • Optimizes English, Japanese, and Korean voice-overs for story scenes and combat sequences of previous versions. Issue Fixes ▶ Agents & Enemies • Fixes an issue where certain enemies had abnormal Anti-Interrupt levels. • Fixes an issue in Hollow Zero: Operation Matrix where, under certain circumstances, using Auxiliary Agent Manato's Auxiliary Assist could cause subsequent Agent Ultimate activations to behave abnormally. • Fixes an issue in Hollow Zero: Operation Matrix where Pyrois's Ultimate would trigger abnormally after using Auxiliary Agent Manato's Lv. 4 Auxiliary Assist. • Fixes an issue in Hollow Zero: Operation Matrix where, after Agent Evelyn is equipped with the Gear Lethal Etiquette, hitting an enemy with any squad member's Quick Assist would fail to properly restore Burning Embers for Evelyn. • Fixes an issue in Hollow Zero: Operation Matrix where, after Agent Cissia is equipped with the Gear Coiled Strike, the Chain Attack window would open abnormally when Cissia was not on-field. • Fixes an issue during combat against Integrated: Shining Promise - Billy in Annihilation Simulacrum, where Agents within the Starlight Arena area might not correctly obtain Etch. • Fixes an issue where Agent Pyrois's actions could appear abnormal on the Agent menu. Proxy masih dapat mengaksesnya melalui sistem pengumuman. • Menyesuaikan gameplay "Bangbang! Si Jenius dan Chip Ajaib!". Setelah "Pembangtoo" mencapai level maksimum, hadiah "Misi Proxy Harian" diperbarui menjadi item rekonstruksi "Modul Bangboo". • Mengoptimalisasi tampilan sebagian petunjuk dan label dalam gameplay "Bangbang! Si Jenius dan Chip Ajaib!". • Menyesuaikan Sintesis Kartu Layanan "Pembersihan Total" menjadi "Kartu Listrik Prabayar" ke "Logistik Outpost". Proxy dapat menggunakan Kartu Layanan "Pembersihan Total" untuk menukarkan "Kartu Listrik Prabayar". • Menyesuaikan sebagian notifikasi titik merah di "Panduan". • Mengoptimalisasi aturan terkait fitur "Buang Otomatis" pada Drive Disc. • Mengoptimalisasi posisi teleportasi di Kota Booastrum - "Cabang Toko Video" untuk menghindari interaksi yang tidak disengajai. • Mengoptimalisasi sebagian tampilan visual dan efek Booastrum. • Mengoptimalisasi sebagian tampilan visual dan efek Resor Fantasy. • Menyesuaikan konfigurasi kualitas grafis default pada sebagian perangkat iPhone (seperti iPhone12, iPhone13, dll). • Memperbaiki kesalahan penulisan pada sebagian teks. • Menyesuaikan, mengoptimalisasi, dan memperbaiki beberapa teks dalam game (tidak akan memengaruhi gameplay atau sistem). • Mengoptimalisasi sulih suara Bahasa Inggris, Bahasa Jepang, dan Bahasa Korea di beberapa alur cerita dan pertarungan di versi sebelumnya. [Perbaikan Masalah] ▶ Agen dan Musuh • Memperbaiki masalah Level Anti-Interrupt untuk beberapa musuh. • Memperbaiki masalah yang menyebabkan Ultimate Agen selanjutnya tidak dapat dilancarkan dengan normal setelah menggunakan "Assist Pendukung" Agen Pendukung Manato dalam kondisi tertentu di "Hollow Zero: Operasi Matriks". • Memperbaiki masalah yang menyebabkan Ultimate "Pyrois" tidak dapat dilancarkan dengan normal setelah menggunakan "Assist Pendukung" Lv. 4 Agen Pendukung Manato dalam kondisi tertentu di "Hollow Zero: Operasi Matriks". • Memperbaiki masalah di mana saat Agen "Evelyn" sedang membawa senjata "Lethal Etiquette", "Burning Ember" tidak dapat dipulihkan secara normal untuk Evelyn saat Quick Assist saat salah satu anggota tim mengenai musuh di "Hollow Zero: Operasi Matriks" • Memperbaiki masalah di mana saat Agen "Cissia" sedang membawa senjata "Coiled Strike", jendela "Chain Attack" terbuka secara abnormal saat "Cissia" tidak di medan pertempuran di "Hollow Zero: Operasi Matriks". • Memperbaiki masalah yang menyebabkan Agen kemungkinan tidak memperoleh "Etch" dengan benar saat berada di area "Starlight Arena" dalam pertarungan "Simulasi Pertempuran Pemusnahan" melawan "Integrated: Shining Promise - Billy". • Memperbaiki masalah gerakan yang kemungkinan abnormal pada antarmuka Agen "Pyrois". • Memperbaiki masalah tampilan rambut Agen "Promeia" yang abnormal di antarmuka "Pemilihan Agen". • Memperbaiki masalah sebagian gerakan yang kemungkinan abnormal pada Agen "Norma". • Memperbaiki masalah tampilan model beberapa Agen dan NPC yang mungkin abnormal. • Memperbaiki masalah adanya kemungkinan Kelipatan Stun DMG menjadi tidak normal setelah "Girtablullu" keluar dari status Stun saat bertarung melawannya di "Operasi Serbuan Maut". • Memperbaiki masalah serangan Agen "Soldier 0 - Anby" yang tidak mengenai musuh secara normal setelah melancarkan "Ultimate: Voidstrike" dalam situasi tertentu. ▶ Sistem • Memperbaiki masalah lag yang terjadi saat pertama kali menjalankan game dalam mode DX12. Untuk memastikan pengalaman bermain yang optimal setelah update versi ini, shader akan dikompilasi ulang satu kali saat game dijalankan menggunakan DX12. • Memperbaiki masalah progres Misi Ekspansi "Dana Kota New Eridu" yang kemungkinan tidak tercatat dengan benar setelah berpartisipasi dalam gameplay "Perburuan Keji". • Memperbaiki masalah tampilan dan modifikasi pada antarmuka "Gelar". ▶ Musik & Efek Suara • Memperbaiki masalah pada suara dalam beberapa bahasa yang terkadang hilang saat menggunakan fitur percepat 2x dalam cerita. • Memperbaiki masalah musik dan efek suara yang kemungkinan abnormal dalam situasi tertentu. ▶ Area • Memperbaiki masalah tampilan lingkungan yang kemungkinan abnormal dalam beberapa kondisi tertentu. ▶ Lainnya • Memperbaiki masalah teks dan tanda baca pada beberapa misi, antarmuka, dan deskripsi. [Optimalisasi Deskripsi Teks Skill Agen, W-Engine & Drive Disc] ▶ Agen • Menambahkan efek Skill Inti "Additional Ability: Bask in Frost" milik Agen "Hoshimi Miyabi". Setelah ditambahkan: Berlaku jika terdapat Agen Stun, Agen Support, Agen yang berasal dari faksi yang sama, atau Agen Anomaly lainnya di dalam tim. • Menambahkan efek Skill Inti "Additional Ability: Synced Acceleration" milik Agen Piper. desc.en: Travelers can earn rich rewards in "Frostfarer" during the event duration. Unlock Gnostic Hymn or Gnostic Chorus to further earn Intertwined Fate and a designated 4-star weapon! Purchase Gnostic Chorus directly to get the exclusive BP namecard "Travel Notes: Frostfarer" and Furnishing Blueprint "Dancing Beneath Silver-White Wings" and Dust of Enlightenment . 〓Event Duration〓 After the Version 7.0 update – 2026/09/21 03:59 〓Eligibility〓 Adventure Rank 20 or above 〓Event Details〓 ● Sojourner's Battle Pass will be unlocked by default every BP Period. Travelers can also unlock either Gnostic Hymn or Gnostic Chorus in order to earn even more rewards, or directly purchase Gnostic Chorus at a discounted price. ● Starting from this Battle Pass, on top of the ten 4-star weapons already in the BP Bounty, the following new 4-star weapons will also be available: Heretic's Molten Blade (Sword), Forged by the Golden Melody (Claymore), Frostbreath (Polearm), Clash of Kings (Catalyst), and Jade Vista (Bow) . Reach Gnostic Hymn Level 30 to select any one of these fifteen weapons from the BP Bounty. ※ Travelers who have already unlocked Gnostic Hymn need only exchange the remaining difference in cost through purchasing Travel Notes in order to unlock Gnostic Chorus. ※ The purchasing of Gnostic Hymn, Gnostic Chorus, and Travel Notes for this Battle Pass will end on 2026/09/21 02:59 . Travelers can still complete Battle Pass Missions and claim rewards after the purchase period ends. Travelers, please take note of the purchase period and start time of the Battle Pass. ● After unlocking Gnostic Hymn or Gnostic Chorus, you will unlock the Chronicle Boon effect, granting a discount when purchasing the corresponding Miliastra Pass in Miliastra Wonderland. Likewise, unlocking Chronicles of the Realms or Epic of the Realms will grant the Battle Pass Boon effect, offering a discount when purchasing the corresponding Battle Pass in Teyvat. You can check the Boon button on the Miliastra Pass or Battle Pass purchase screen for more details. The Boon effect can only be activated once during the current event period. ● The Battle Pass and Miliastra Pass share the same start and end dates each period. Please be sure to check the time and claim your rewards promptly.

desc.en: 〓Event Rewards〓 〓Event Duration〓 Event Duration: 2026/08/19 10:00 - 2026/09/22 03:59 Disturbance Outbreak: 2026/08/19 10:00 - 2026/08/29 03:59 〓Eligibility〓 Adventure Rank 20 or above And complete Archon Quest Prologue: Act III "Song of the Dragon and Freedom" ※ Complete Archon Quest "Perilous Trail" first to get the best experience from this event. 〓Event Details〓 ● Challenge gameplay: You must select a difficulty first. After you enter a challenge, you must complete 3 phases, for a total of 3 time-limited battles. The challenge is considered complete once all opponents in all 3 battles are beaten. ● Difficulty: difficulty levels in ascending order are "Normal," "Advancing," "Hard," "Menacing," "Fearless," and "Dire." The higher the initial difficulty selected, the more restrictive the rules applied during the challenge, and the tougher enemies will be. From the "Hard" difficulty onward, you can only unlock the next difficulty by clearing the current one. ● "Exalted Ones": There can be a maximum of 16 "Exalted Ones" at any one time during the challenge. "Exalted Ones" will obtain buff effects; adding them to your party will help you complete the challenge. There can be a maximum of 16 "Exalted Ones" at any one time during the challenge, and their number is subject to change. Under the "Dire" difficulty, "Exalted Ones" no longer obtain buff effects. ● Disturbance Outbreak: In the first 10 days from when the challenge is available, the Ley Line disturbance will be in an "Outbreak" state. During the Disturbance Outbreak, players with Adventure Rank 45 and above can challenge stages at "Hard" difficulty onwards, and upon completing them, can consume Resin to earn the rewards from their chosen Domains of Blessing, while also accumulating Dire Prestige. Accumulate a certain amount of Dire Prestige to receive extra Artifact rewards and Dust of Enlightenment . After the Disturbance Outbreak ends, players will not be able to consume Resins to claim rewards from their selected Domain of Blessing. ● Completing a more difficult challenge will also let you obtain the rewards from the difficulties below that one. Rewards for "Fearless" and "Dire" difficulties can only be claimed upon completing the single-player challenge. ● Co-Op Mode: All difficulty levels support Co-Op Mode of up to 4 players. "Normal," "Advancing," and "Hard" difficulties support matchmaking or Co-Op Mode within the same world. "Menacing," "Fearless," and "Dire" difficulties only support Co-Op challenges within the same world. ※ Starting from this event, a new weapon appearance style will be added to "Radiant Phantasm" and "Radiant Phantasm: Sublimation." Upon obtaining them, both the new and old weapon appearances will be obtained together.
desc.id: 〓 Hadiah Event 〓 〓 Waktu Event 〓 Waktu Event: 2026/08/19 10:00 - 2026/09/22 03:59 Disturbance Outbreak: 2026/08/19 10:00 - 2026/08/29 03:59 〓 Syarat Partisipasi 〓 Rank Adventure Lv. 20 ke atas Dan telah menyelesaikan Quest Archon Prolog: Bag. III "Lagu Naga dan Kebebasan" ※ Selesaikan Quest Archon "Jalur Berbahaya" terlebih dahulu untuk pengalaman bermain yang lebih baik. 〓 Penjelasan Event 〓 ● Gameplay tantangan: Traveler harus memilih 1 tingkat kesulitan sebelum memasuki tantangan. Setelah memasuki tantangan, Traveler harus menyelesaikan 3 pertempuran dan mengalahkan semua musuh dalam batas waktu. Traveler akan dianggap berhasil setelah berhasil menyelesaikan ketiga tantangan. ● Tingkat kesulitan：Mulai dari "Normal", "Lanjutan", "Sulit", "Mengancam", "Ekstra Sulit", dan "Ekstrem". Semakin tinggi tingkat kesulitan yang dipilih, semakin banyak batasan yang ada dalam tantangannya, dan semakin kuat pula musuhnya. Mulai dari tingkat "Sulit", Traveler harus menyelesaikan tingkat kesulitan tersebut untuk membuka tingkat kesulitan berikutnya. ● "Exalted One": Dalam tantangan, maksimum 16 Karakter dapat menjadi "Exalted One" di saat yang sama. "Exalted One" bisa mendapatkan buff, jadi ayo tambahkan ke dalam party-mu untuk menyelesaikan tantangannya dengan lebih mudah. Maksimum bisa ada 16 "Exalted One" di saat yang sama dalam suatu tantangan, dan jumlahnya dapat berubah tergantung pada situasi. Dalam tingkat kesulitan "Ekstrem", "Exalted One" tidak akan mendapatkan buff. ● Disturbance Outbreak: Selama 10 hari setelah tantangan dibuka, Gangguan Ley Line akan berada di dalam status "Outbreak" Selama Disturbance Outbreak, pemain dengan Rank Adventure 45 ke atas dapat menantang tingkat kesulitan "Sulit" atau lebih tinggi, dan dapat menggunakan Original Resin untuk mengambil hadiah dari Domain of Blessing yang dipilih, serta mengakumulasi Dire Prestige. Akumulasi "Dire Prestige" hingga jumlah tertentu untuk mendapatkan hadiah Artefak tambahan dan Dust of Enlightenment . Setelah Disturbance Outbreak berakhir, Traveler tidak dapat mengonsumsi Original Resin lagi untuk mengambil hadiah dari Domain of Blessing yang dipilih. ● Pengambilan Hadiah: Menyelesaikan tantangan di tingkat kesulitan yang lebih tinggi juga akan memberikanmu semua hadiah dari tingkat kesulitan di bawahnya. Hadiah untuk tingkat kesulitan "Ekstra Sulit" dan "Ekstrem" hanya bisa diambil setelah menyelesaikan tantangan dalam Mode Solo. ● Mode Co-Op: Semua tingkat kesulitan mendukung Mode Co-Op 4 orang. Tingkat kesulitan "Normal", "Lanjutan", dan "Sulit" mendukung Mode Matchmaking atau Co-Op di dunia yang sama. Tingkat kesulitan "Mengancam", "Ekstra Sulit", dan "Ekstrem" hanya mendukung Mode Co-Op di dunia yang sama. ※ Mulai dari event ini, "Radiant Phantasm" dan "Radiant Phantasm: Sublimation" akan menambahkan satu set tampilan senjata baru. Setelah mendapatkannya, Traveler akan mendapatkan tampilan senjata lama dan baru sekaligus.

desc.en: Dear Trailblazers, During the event, Trailblazers can increase their Nameless Honor level to obtain rewards such as Star Rail Passes, Self-Modeling Resins, and Tracks of Destiny. After unlocking Nameless Glory, you will immediately obtain Stellar Jade ×680. In addition, increasing Nameless Honor levels will allow Trailblazers to obtain Light Cone Memory Shard ×1, Star Rail Special Pass ×4, a 4-star Light Cone of your choice, Variable Dice ×1, Self-Modeling Resin ×2, Relic Remains, the universal Path material Tears of Dreams, and more! If the Trailblazer unlocks the Nameless Medal, in addition to the previous rewards, they will immediately increase their Honor level by 10, and obtain the avatar "Robin • Summeretto: Race," the avatar "Aventurine • Waveflair: Race," Light Cone Memory Shard ×1, Stellar Jade ×200, and Fuel rewards! ※ The EXP required to level up "Nameless Honor" this period will be reduced, and the EXP obtained from some Nameless Honor missions will also be adjusted accordingly. This will allow Trailblazers to obtain Level Rewards faster within the 5-week period. For more details, please check within the game. Start Date After the Version 4.5 update — 2026/09/28 03:59:00 Participation Requirements Trailblaze Level ≥ 12 and have completed the Trailblaze Mission "Jarilo-VI — Long Wait for the Blade's Edge" About Nameless Honor After Nameless Honor is unlocked, the Nameless Gift will automatically be unlocked. Trailblazers can obtain EXP and increase their Nameless Honor level via This Week's Missions and This Period's Missions. The maximum Nameless Honor level is capped at Level 70. Attaining specific levels will allow the Trailblazer to obtain Star Rail Passes, Self-Modeling Resin, Tracks of Destiny, and more. This Week's Missions will reset every Monday at 04:00 (server time). Trailblazers who have unlocked the Nameless Glory can purchase Honor Badge to upgrade to Nameless Medal. Attention After reaching level cap, EXP will no longer be awarded through missions during this period. In the event of special circumstances leading to the repeated purchase of Nameless Glory or Nameless Medal, The Nameless EXP will not be accumulated, and Oneiric Shards ×750 (or Oneiric Shards ×1,410) will be refunded depending on the price of the purchase. In the event of special circumstances leading to the repeated purchase of the Honor Badge, Oneiric Shards ×860 will be refunded. The purchase of Nameless Glory, Nameless Medal, and Honor Badge will be closed for this period at 2026/09/28 02:59:00 . After the purchase is closed, Trailblazers can still complete the Nameless Honor missions and receive rewards. Please note the available purchase time and event period. In the webpage top-up center, the purchase deadline for Nameless Glory, Nameless Medal, and Honor Badge will be 2026/09/27 03:59:00 . Trailblazers who top up on the webpage should pay attention to the purchase availability time.
desc.id: Dear Trailblazer, Selama event berlangsung, Trailblazer dapat meningkatkan level "Kehormatan Tanpa Nama" untuk memperoleh Star Rail Pass, Self-Modeling Resin, Tracks of Destiny dan hadiah lainnya. Setelah membuka "Nameless Glory", kamu akan langsung mendapatkan Stellar Jade ×680. Tingkatkan level "Kehormatan Tanpa Nama" untuk memperoleh tambahan Light Cone Memory Shard ×1, Star Rail Special Pass ×4, Light Cone 4★ yang diinginkan, Variable Dice ×1, Self-Modeling Resin ×2, Relic Remains, Material Path Umum "Tears of Dreams", dan hadiah lainnya! Jika Trailblazer membuka "Nameless Medal", maka selain hadiah yang di atas, Trailblazer dapat langsung menaikkan 10 level Kehormatan Tanpa Nama, juga memperoleh hadiah avatar "Robin • Summeretto: Kompetisi", avatar "Aventurine • Waveflair: Kompetisi", Light Cone Memory Shard ×1, Stellar Jade ×200, Fuel dan hadiah lainnya! ※ EXP yang diperlukan untuk menaikkan level "Kehormatan Tanpa Nama" periode ini akan dikurangi, EXP yang diperoleh dari sebagian Misi Kehormatan juga akan disesuaikan, agar Trailblazer dapat memperoleh Hadiah Level lebih cepat dalam 5 minggu. Setelah mencapai Level Kehormatan Tanpa Nama yang ditentukan, Trailblazer akan mendapatkan Star Rail Pass, Self-Modeling Resin, Tracks of Destiny, dan hadiah lainnya. Misi Minggu Ini akan reset setiap hari Senin pukul 04:00 (waktu server). Jika perlu, Trailblazer yang telah membuka "Nameless Glory" dapat meng-upgrade ke "Nameless Medal" dengan membeli "Honor Badge". Perhatian Selama event ini berlangsung, Trailblazer tidak akan bisa mendapatkan EXP melalui misi jika sudah mencapai level maksimum. Jika kondisi khusus menyebabkan Trailblazer melakukan pembelian "Nameless Glory" atau "Nameless Medal" secara berulang, "The Nameless EXP" tidak akan bertambah dan Trailblazer akan mendapatkan pengembalian Oneiric Shard sebesar nilai pembelian Oneiric Shard ×750 atau nilai pembelian Oneiric Shard ×1.410. Jika kondisi khusus menyebabkan Trailblazer melakukan pembelian "Honor Badge" secara berulang, Trailblazer akan mendapatkan pengembalian Oneiric Shard sebesar nilai pembelian Oneiric Shard ×860. Pada 2026/09/28 02:59:00 , pembelian "Nameless Glory", "Nameless Medal", dan "Honor Badge" untuk periode event kali ini akan ditutup. Setelah pembelian ditutup, Trailblazer masih bisa menyelesaikan misi Kehormatan Tanpa Nama dan mengambil hadiah. Harap Trailblazer perhatikan waktu pembelian dan durasi event. Waktu pembelian item "Nameless Glory", "Nameless Medal" dan "Honor Badge" di pusat top-up web akan berakhir pada 2026/09/27 03:59:00 . Harap Trailblazer yang menggunakan top-up web perhatikan waktu pembelian.
