subtitle.en: To Temper Thyself and Journey Far

desc.en: 〓Event Rewards〓 〓Event Duration〓 2026/08/10 04:00 - 2026/11/02 03:59 〓Eligibility〓 Adventure Rank 14 or above Complete "Knights of Favonius" in Archon Quest Prologue: Act I to unlock the Wish system Complete the World Quest "Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild" to unlock the Adventurer Handbook 〓Event Details〓 ● During the event, claim rewards from 4 Daily Commissions and expend 120 Original Resin in a single day to complete daily training goals. Complete daily training goals 5 times in a week to complete the weekly training goal for that week. You will accumulate progress for completing weekly training goals, which can be exchanged for the corresponding stage rewards. ● When you complete 8 weekly training goals, you can claim the Stella Fortuna reward. Travelers can select a desired character's Stella Fortuna from the characters on the event page's roster. ※ Stella Fortuna cannot be obtained for characters you have not obtained, or for characters who have already obtained a Stella Fortuna from past "To Temper Thyself and Journey Far" events. ※ During each season of the "To Temper Thyself and Journey Far" event, unclaimed Stella Fortuna rewards (earned by completing objectives) can only be exchanged for characters available in the current season. The selection opportunity does not carry over to the next season, so please select your character for exchange promptly. ● In the current cycle of "To Temper Thyself and Journey Far," complete 8 weekly training goals to unlock Tempered in Practice for the following week. Once unlocked, you will receive extra rewards for completing weekly training goals. This bonus resets weekly, so be sure to claim your extra rewards in time. ● After the current cycle of "To Temper Thyself and Journey Far" concludes, the next cycle will begin on the following Monday at 04:00. ※ Starting from this "To Temper Thyself and Journey Far" event, Stella Fortuna for the following characters will be permanently added to the available redemption rewards: Lyney, Wriothesley, Navia, Sigewinne, Clorinde, Emilie, Chiori, Xianyun, Yumemizuki Mizuki.
desc.id: 〓 Hadiah Event 〓 〓 Waktu Event 〓 2026/08/10 04:00 - 2026/11/02 03:59 〓 Syarat Partisipasi 〓 Rank Adventure Lv. 14 ke atas Telah menyelesaikan "Knights of Favonius" dalam Quest Archon Prolog: Bag. I "Pengembara yang Menangkap Angin" dan membuka fitur Permohonan Selesaikan Quest Dunia "Selamat datang di Adventurers' Guild" dan membuka Buku Panduan Petualang 〓 Penjelasan Event 〓 ● Setelah event berlangsung, ambil Hadiah Misi Harian 4 kali atau gunakan 120 Original Resin untuk menyelesaikan Target Latihan Harian. Selesaikan 5 kali Target Latihan Harian untuk menyelesaikan Target Latihan Mingguan. Saat berhasil mencapai Target Latihan minggu ini, kamu akan mengakumulasi kemajuan penyelesaian yang bisa ditukarkan dengan hadiah tahapan. ● Dalam setiap periode Perjalanan Menempa Diri Tanpa Henti, capai Target Latihan Mingguan 8 kali untuk mendapatkan hadiah Stella Fortuna. Traveler dapat memilih Stella Fortuna Karakter yang diinginkan dari daftar Karakter di halaman event. ※ Kamu tidak bisa menukarkan Stella Fortuna Karakter yang tidak dimiliki, ataupun menukarkan Stella Fortuna Karakter yang sudah pernah didapatkan dari Perjalanan Menempa Diri Tanpa Henti periode sebelumnya. ※ Di setiap periode event "Perjalanan Menempa Diri Tanpa Henti", hadiah Stella Fortuna yang sudah diterima tapi belum ditukarkan hanya bisa digunakan untuk menukar Karakter di periode ini. Kesempatan memilih tidak bisa dibawa ke periode berikutnya, jadi mohon segera menukarkan Karakter yang diinginkan, ya! ● Dalam "Perjalanan Menempa Diri Tanpa Henti" periode ini, selesaikan target latihan mingguan 8 kali untuk membuka Pelatihan Penempaan minggu berikutnya. Setelah terbuka, Traveler bisa mendapatkan hadiah tambahan saat menyelesaikan target latihan minggu ini. Pelatihan Penempaan akan di-reset setiap minggu. Harap mengambil hadiah tambahan tepat pada waktunya. ● Setelah "Perjalanan Menempa Diri Tanpa Henti" periode ini berakhir, maka periode berikutnya akan dimulai pada hari Senin pukul 04:00. ※ Mulai dari "Perjalanan Menempa Diri Tanpa Henti" periode ini, Stella Fortuna Karakter berikut akan ditambahkan secara permanen dalam hadiah yang dapat ditukarkan: Lyney, Wriothesley, Navia, Sigewinne, Clorinde, Emilie, Chiori, Xianyun, dan Yumemizuki Mizuki.

title.en: Version 3.0 "A Sleepwalker's Confession" Update Announcement
title.id: Pengumuman Update Versi 3.0 "Pengakuan Seorang Parasomnia"

desc.en: Dear Proxies, Below is the updated content and compensation for Version 3.0 "A Sleepwalker's Confession." [Update Start Time] 2026/06/17 06:00 (UTC+8) It will take about five hours to complete. [Compensation Details] • Server Update Compensation Compensation: Polychrome ×300 Requirements: Reach Inter-Knot Lv. 4 before 2026/06/17 06:00 (UTC+8) . ※ Can be claimed until the end of Version 3.0. Please note that Version 3.0 will run for 42 days, ending on 2026/07/29 06:00 (UTC+8) . • Issue Fix Compensation Compensation: Polychrome ×300 Requirements: Reach Inter-Knot Lv. 4 before 2026/06/17 06:00 (UTC+8) . Please log in to the game and claim the compensation before 2026/07/17 23:59 (UTC+8) . The dev team will issue the compensation via in-game mail after the update has been completed. The mail will expire after 30 days, so don't forget to claim the attachments. [How to Update] • PC Exit the game, restart, then select update. • Android After entering the game, follow the in-game pop-up instructions to complete the update. • iOS Go to the App Store and select update. • PS5™ or PS5™ Pro Open the PS5 home screen > Highlight Zenless Zone Zero > Hold down the Options button on your controller > Check for updates. • Xbox Series X|S Open your Xbox dashboard > My games & apps > Manage > Select Zenless Zone Zero on the Updates page and confirm the update. [New Content] 1. New Agents • S-Rank Agent Velina (Wind - Anomaly) Can be obtained through the "Graceful Gale" Signal Search. • S-Rank Agent Norma (Stun - Fire) Can be obtained through the "Outlier of Prodigies" Signal Search. • Phaethon Faction Agent Pyrois (Ether - Attack) Complete Season 3 Main Mission "Treating Symptoms" to obtain. 2. New W-Engines • S-Rank W-Engine Joyau Dore (Anomaly) Can be obtained through the "Joyau Dore" Signal Search. • S-Rank W-Engine Chief Sidekick (Stun) Can be obtained through the "Chief Sidekick" Signal Search. • S-Rank W-Engine Sol Exuvia (Attack) Progress through the Season 3 main story commission and unlock the Interboo, then raise your Interboo level to obtain. • A-Rank W-Engine Boisterous Echoes (Anomaly) Can be obtained through the "Assemble! Mock Exam Comeback Plan" event. 3. New Bangboo • S-Rank Bangboo Ultra Jake Can be obtained through An Outstanding Partner Signal Search. 4. New Story • Main Story Season 3 Chapter 1 "A Sleepwalker's Confession" I dreamed of another me, in a dream I would never wake up from. Availability: Permanently available after the Version 3.0 update Requirements: Complete Main Story Season 2 - Epilogue "New: Eridan Sunset (B)" ※ You can experience this content in advance via the Advance Screening function after ranking up in Season 1 Chapter 1 - Intermission. • Agent Trust Events, Quality Time Events New Agent Trust Events and Quality Time Events for Velina and Norma. Availability: Permanently available after the Version 3.0 update Requirements: Obtain the corresponding Agents and complete the required Stories (Please see Workbench > Partner Archive) 5. New Area • Adds a new area: Roscaelifer - Booastrum Adds ambient events in the main city of Roscaelifer. Roscaelifer exists to ensure the long-term, stable output of Rosetta Data. Independent from the urban district of New Eridu, it operates as a classified airspace zone known as the Celestial Nexus. Unlock Condition: Unlocked during Main Story Season 3 Chapter 1 "A Sleepwalker's Confession" 6. New Outfits • Velina: Shade of Leisure Outside of work, Velina occasionally invites close friends to afternoon tea parties. During such moments, she changes into relatively casual attire to enjoy her free time... Though until the misunderstanding about the "witch" is cleared up, to the Bangboo, it's merely the Grim Reaper in a different terrifying disguise. ※ After the Version 3.0 update – 2026/07/29 05:59 (UTC+8), Velina's Shade of Leisure outfit will be on sale at a limited-time discount in Store - Today's Outfit. During the discount period, the price is Monochrome ×1,350. After the discount period ends, the price will revert to Monochrome ×1,680. Limited to one purchase during the sale period. • Wise: Oath of Skies Leap into the sky like a movie protagonist. The clouds freeze for an instant, as howling gales and raging storms temper your unwavering resolution. • Belle: Brilliance of Stars Sweep across the night like a phantom of the silver screen. The galaxy flickers for an instant, as dawn and dusk coalesce into your unchanged path home. ※ Progress the Season 3 Chapter 1 main story "A Sleepwalker's Confession" to the designated commission to claim Wise's new outfit Oath of Skies and Belle's new outfit Brilliance of Stars for free. 7. New Events • All-New Program During the event, log in for a total of 7 days to earn Encrypted Master Tape ×10! — My new friends, see you on the Exclusive Channel! Event Duration: After the Version 3.0 update – 2026/07/28 03:59 (server time) Requirements: Reach Inter-Knot Lv. 5, complete the Main Story Prologue "The Hare and the Proxy," and unlock the Event feature • Commemorative Gift As your new story begins, accept this gift from above the clouds. In commemoration of the journey we experienced together. Event Duration: After the Version 3.0 update – 2026/07/29 05:59 (UTC+8) Requirements: Reach Inter-Knot Lv. 5, complete the Main Story Prologue "The Hare and the Proxy," and unlock the Event feature • Bangbang! The Genius and the Miracle Chip We've invented... a path to tomorrow, woven from regret and hope! Event Duration: After the Version 3.0 update – 2026/07/29 05:59 (UTC+8) Requirements: Unlock the Central Computing Hub in the Main Story Season 3 Chapter 1 Mission "Celestial Nexus" to participate • Celestial Nexus Intelligence Dossier With this dossier in hand, all the intel on Roscaelifer is within your grasp. Now go! Claim every inch of that sky! Event Duration: After the Version 3.0 update – 2026/07/29 05:59 (UTC+8) Requirements: Unlock Main Story Season 3 Chapter 1 "A Sleepwalker's Confession" to participate • Gleaming Shadow Team Battle Fist bump, high five — swap! We all overcome hardship through supporting one another. Event Duration: 2026/06/19 10:00 (server time) – 2026/07/13 03:59 (server time) Requirements: Reach Inter-Knot Lv. 20 and complete Main Story Chapter 1 - Intermission to participate • Assemble! Mock Exam Comeback Plan This is unprecedented! The academy's top-tier course just hit a zero pass rate catastrophe... The mock exam comeback plan is live, and we're waiting on you: our savior! Event Duration: 2026/06/26 10:00 (server time) – 2026/07/27 03:59 (server time) Requirements: Reach Inter-Knot Lv. 20 and complete Main Story Chapter 1 - Intermission to participate • Advanced Bounty: Area Patrol During the event, Area Patrol rewards will be doubled. "Battle is almost upon us! Rest assured, the Defense Force will show you who we truly are." Event Duration: 2026/07/02 04:00 (server time) – 2026/07/07 03:59 (server time) Requirements: Reach Inter-Knot Lv. 21, complete the Reputation Rank-Up Mission "Path of the Proxy I," and unlock Area Patrol to participate • Tales of the Hobbling Crow Welcome to The Hobbling Crow detective agency. We're happy to be of service! Disclaimer: The investigation progress depends on... your offered commission fee, and how long the vice president spends slacking. All hail Bangboo! We all love Bangboo! Bangboo surprise boxes are on sale now! Come see true art! New Gameplay • Annihilation Simulacrum Proxies can choose Agents to deploy from a selection of trial Agents and challenge highly dangerous targets previously fought before. These enemies will be enhanced with new attacks or mechanics and higher DMG. "Annihilation Simulacrum" offers two difficulties for each combat target. The Standard stage is easier, letting Proxies get familiar with enemies' new mechanics in a relatively easy environment. The Extreme stage is much tougher, with enemies dealing significantly more damage and having greatly increased HP. Upon clearing the Extreme stage, the system records the fastest clear time and ranks them on a server-wide leaderboard. Challenge powerful enemies and complete missions to earn the exclusive avatar "Simulated Annihilation: Terminus," Polychromes, and various upgrade materials as rewards. Availability: After the Version 3.0 update Requirements: Reach Inter-Knot Lv. 55 and unlock Booastrum in Main Story Season 3 Chapter 1 "A Sleepwalker's Confession" to participate • Interboo Expansion Plan From gazing up at the sky to measuring its depths. Explore Roscaelifer and level up your Interboo account. • Proxies can unlock various content in the Interboo system by exploring Booastrum and submitting Interboo Coins to upgrade their Interboo level. Complete Interboo-related gameplay to earn Pyrois Agent Mindscapes, the Pyrois Agent Exclusive W-Engine Sol Exuvia, Polychromes, and various upgrade material rewards. (*More rewards will be added with future version updates.) Availability: After the Version 3.0 update Requirements: Unlock the Interboo in Main Story Season 3 Chapter 1 commission "Celestial Nexus" to participate in the Interboo account level-up gameplay • Roarin' Brekkies After the Version 3.0 update, you can draw a snack surprise box once every day at Roarin' Brekkies, run by Mr. Roar in Roscaelifer, to obtain data cards and their corresponding rewards. Collect data cards of different rarities to earn Lucky Bottle Caps and make wishes at the Fountain of the Bottle Cap Fairy. * The surprise box draw shares a daily limit with divination readings and scratch cards. If you draw a surprise box, divination and scratch cards will be unavailable for the rest of the day. • Aerial Transit Proxies can harness Pyrois' spatial movement abilities to dash along the tracks, zipping to wherever they need to go in a flash. • Universal Terminal Access Proxies can unlock the Universal Terminal Access, gaining a broader view through the first-person perspective of surveillance cameras across Roscaelifer, scanning and accessing specific targets to obtain critical information. • Bangboo Drone Proxies can control Eous to move the drone and interact with the environment. The drone is equipped with two skills: charge and destroy. When approaching a target that can be charged, a connection prompt will appear. When approaching a target that can be destroyed, the object will display a special visual indicator. Proxies can activate the drone's skills by following the on-screen guidance. • Singularity Leakage After Proxies activates the Singularity Leakage, the surroundings, objects, and enemies in the area will change. Proxies can directly eliminate the Singularity Leakage itself by using Pyrois' abilities to escape. 9. Other New Content ▶ New Content • Adds the "Pilot and the Rebel Mech" challenge to Area Patrol, where the new Drive Discs, Wuthering Salon and The Sky Ablaze, can be obtained. • New enemies Integrated - Primordial Nightmare - "The Creator," Girtablullu, Metamorphosed - Avarus, Metamorphosed - Scorpse, Autonomous Assault Unit - Airspace Sentinel, Doppelganger - Starlight - Billy, Shining Promise - Billy, Metamorphosed - Tarasque Mixer, City Guardboo, Lahmu, Mutant Formicarrier, Metamorphosed - Beholder Engine, Airspace Patrolboo, Special Anti-Riotboo, Metamorphosed - Airspace Patrolboo, Metamorphosed - Special Anti-Riotboo, and Kulullu have been added. • Adds new areas: the Central Computing Department, Sunken Corridor, and the Energy Hub. • The Map system now includes new scenes and gameplay-related map content for Version 3.0. When hidden spaces and Singularity Leakages are activated, the map will also sync and update area information in real time. Air bus activity in the city will be displayed on the map dynamically and in real time. • Dynamic wallpapers for Agents Velina and Norma have been added. Obtain the corresponding Agent and increase your Trust Level to a certain amount to unlock. • Adds new achievements related to Phaethon's Story, Agent Trust, When Opportunities Converge, Proxy Business, Booastrum, Combat Techniques, Hostile Targets, Combat Achievements, and Investigation Zone Adventures, including some hidden achievements. • Adds new titles related to Agent Trust, Hostile Targets, Roarin' Brekkies, the "Bangbang! The Genius and the Miracle Chip" event, and the "Gleaming Shadow Team Battle" event. Event titles can be obtained for a limited time only. • Adds a new trophy set to the PS5 platform™: Zenless Zone Zero - A Sleepwalker's Confession. • Adds new achievements for the Xbox Series X|S platform. • Adds side missions for hidden space exploration. • Adds Event Demo videos to select event tabs. • Adds a resource bar to the top-right corner of the Compendium, displaying the exact quantities of Battery Charge, Backup Battery Charge, and Ether Batteries owned. • After meeting certain upgrade requirements, the Agent details interface will now display the number of effective Sub-Stat hits for Drive Discs. • A "Smart Discard" feature has been added to Drive Disc dismantling, allowing Proxies to discard unwanted Drive Discs in bulk. • A "Switch Training Target" function has been added to the Drive Disc tuning interface. This allows Proxies to view the Agents suited to the 4-piece and 2-piece sets for the currently selected Drive Disc track. • Drive Disc Partition 5 now includes the Main Stat: Wind DMG Bonus. • A "Glossary" function has been added to the skill descriptions of Agents from Version 3.0 onward, as well as enemies' "Enemy Details" descriptions. Proxies can tap on specific underlined terms to view their definitions. • The Inter-Knot Schedule now displays the latest season's main story chapters and features new chapter tags, making it easier for Proxies to jump in and locate the latest main story chapters. • Adds the new collectible, "Street Tales: Fish Through the Market," to Sān-Z STUDIO. • Adds Dennies as a new exchangeable item to Suibian Temple - Devon Pawnshop. • Adds the Proxy's bedroom in Amber Hall. • Adds the External Strategy Department faction to Workbench - Partner Archive. ▶ Signal Shop • Adds a new "Suit-Up Gift" to Store - Signal Shop - Residual Signal. Proxies can redeem the Suit-Up Gift once per month to select an A-Rank W-Engine from the Stable Channel. Adds Advanced Windbite Chip to the Fading Signal tab, with a monthly redemption limit of 50. Additionally, Advanced Attack Certification Seal, Advanced Stun Certification Seal, Advanced Anomaly Certification Seal, Advanced Support Certification Seal, Advanced Defense Certification Seal, Advanced Rupture Certification Seal, Reinforced Attack Component, Reinforced Stun Component, Reinforced Anomaly Component, Reinforced Support Component, Reinforced Defense Component, and Reinforced Rupture Component have also been added to the Fading Signal tab, with a monthly redemption limit of 35 each. ▶ Shiyu Defense After the Version 3.0 update, the buff effects of Critical Node are as follows: Phase I: • Agent Wind DMG and Ice DMG increase by 30%, Vortex DMG increases by 30%. After an Agent uses an EX Special Attack, their Anomaly Proficiency increases by 40 for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. • Agent Ether DMG increases by 30%, CRIT DMG increases by 40%. When an Agent with the Attack specialty hits an enemy and crits, enemy DEF drops by 10% for 5s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. • Agent Ether Anomaly Buildup Rate and Ice Anomaly Buildup Rate increase by 25%. When Agents inflict an Attribute Anomaly on enemies, their DEF is reduced by 10%, and they take 20% more Attribute Anomaly DMG for 10s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Phase II: • Agent Wind DMG and Ice DMG increase by 10%. When hitting enemies afflicted with an Attribute Anomaly, Agent ATK increases by 15% and ignores 10% of their All-Attribute RES. • Agent's Ultimate and Chain Attack DMG increase by 40%. When Chain Attack hits an enemy, the enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 20% and their Daze recovery slows down by 15%, lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. • Agent ATK increases by 30%, CRIT DMG increases by 15%. Enemy Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 20%. Phase III: • Agent's Chain Attack and Ultimate DMG increase by 40%. When Chain Attack hits an enemy, the enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 20% and their Daze recovery slows down by 15%, lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. • Agent's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 20, and Anomaly DMG dealt increases by 10%. When there are 1/2 Agents with the Anomaly specialty in the squad, Agents ignore 5%/15% of the enemy's All-DMG RES. • Agent's Ice DMG increases by 30%. Agent's Basic Attack and Chain Attack DMG increase by 20%, and CRIT DMG increases by 35%. ▶ Deadly Assault After the Version 3.0 update, the enemies featured in Deadly Assault are as follows: Phase I: Girtablullu, Notorious - Marionette, Ye Shiyuan the Thrall Phase II: Girtablullu, Primordial Nightmare - "The Creator", Ye Shiyuan the Thrall Phase III: Phaethon of the Scorched Horizon, Notorious - Pompey, Miasmic Fiend Unfathomable ※ The end time for Deadly Assault in Version 3.0 Phase III has been adjusted from 2026/07/31 03:59 (server time) to 2026/07/29 03:59 (server time). Proxies, please complete your battles in a timely manner. ▶ Hollow Zero • Adds new Task Force Missions and their corresponding rewards. • Adds Tactical Prism Programs for Agents Velina, Norma, and Pyrois, along with the corresponding Task Force Missions. (Norma's Tactical Prism Program will be made available at the same time as the Agent's Exclusive Channel.) Adjustments & Optimizations ▶ Agents • Adjusts the text placement for certain Mindscape Cinema entries of Agents Astra Yao and Evelyn: Descriptions related to Astra Yao's Mindscape 01: 12-Tone Equal Temperament and Evelyn's Mindscape 01: Dreamweave have been removed from "Investigation Zone Squad Configuration Details." The note stating that Mindscape effects can trigger at most once every 180 seconds in Investigation Zone Mode has been moved to the Mindscape Cinema interface text. This adjustment only affects text placement and has no impact on the actual Mindscape effects. ▶ Systems • Adjusts the Quality Time and Trust Event content for Version 3.0 and subsequent Agents. This adjustment does not affect the amount of Polychrome rewards that can be obtained, while also increasing the efficiency of leveling up Trust levels. • Adjusts the rating style of "Combat Readiness" in the Agent details interface, making it easier to see at a glance which areas need improvement and navigate directly to enhance them. • Optimizes the display style of the Agent - Skills - Upgrade Suggestions interface. • Adjusts the Proxy's outfit accessory system. Accessories such as hats, headwear, earrings, and glasses have been updated as general Proxy outfit accessories, allowing them to be compatible with any combination across all Proxy outfits. • Optimizes global illumination and distant model details on PC. Devices equipped with NVIDIA GeForce RTX 20 Series or above (with RT Core units and at least 8GB VRAM) now support Ray Tracing. Additionally, Frame Generation and Super Resolution based on DLSS/FSR3 have been added. ▶ Others • Optimizes some performance formats. • Optimizes the model performance for NPCs Remielle and Velina. • Optimizes English, Japanese, and Korean voice-overs for story scenes and combat sequences of previous versions. Issue Fixes ▶ Agents & Enemies • Fixes an issue where the enemy Phaethon of the Scorched Horizon would take abnormal Vortex DMG after activating the Gale Scorcher state under certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue where Agent Evelyn experiences abnormal Burning Tether Point recovery under certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue with the text description of Agent Cissia's Mindscape 04: A Rogue's Resolve in the Mindscape Cinema interface, aligning it with the text displayed in the in-combat Mindscape Cinema interface. This adjustment is purely textual and does not affect the actual skill effects. Before: Each stack consumed triggers 1 instance of Corrode Bone that does not consume Venom Fixed: Each stack consumed triggers 1 special instance of Corrode Bone that does not consume Venom • Fixes an issue where enemy HP bars are displayed abnormally during combat under certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue where, under certain circumstances, when Agent Aria is in the same squad as Nangong Yu and Sunna during combat, the models of all three Agents would overlap after Aria uses Basic Attack: Sweet Melody. • Fixes an issue where Agent models could overlap after an Agent triggers a Quick Assist under certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue in Hollow Zero where Agent Corin could experience abnormal activation of Dash Attack: Oopsy-Daisy! - Modified after obtaining the Gear Tea Break Time or Chainsaw Operation Manual. • Fixes an issue where, after enabling the Haptic Feedback function, Agent Starlight - Billy may experience abnormal vibration effects for certain skills during combat. • Fixes an issue where Agent Soukaku's skills Quick Assist: A Set for Two and Dodge Counter: Away From My Snacks were triggering abnormally. This adjustment does not affect the amount of Decibels restored when the skill hits an enemy. ▶ Systems • Adjusts the default setting for the Ray Tracing option in PS5™ Pro and Xbox Series X settings: Ray Tracing will now be turned off by default after the update. Color filter strength will also be restored to its default setting. • Fixes an issue where certain "new" indicators would not properly clear under certain circumstances. ▶ Music & SFX • Fixes an issue where music and sound effects could behave abnormally in certain circumstances. ▶ Others • Fixes text errors in some missions, interfaces, and descriptions. • Fixes some text typos. • Adjusts, improves, and fixes the in-game text for some languages. These changes will not affect gameplay or functions.

"Simulasi Pertempuran Pemusnahan" menyediakan dua versi tingkat kesulitan untuk setiap target pertempuran. Stage Standard memiliki tingkat kesulitan yang lebih rendah, sehingga Proxy dapat mengenal mekanisme baru musuh dalam lingkungan yang lebih santai. Stage Extreme jauh lebih menantang, dengan DMG dan HP musuh yang meningkat drastis. Setelah menyelesaikan stage "Extreme", sistem akan mencatat waktu penyelesaian tercepat Proxy dan mengatur peringkat berdasarkan data tersebut untuk seluruh server. Selesaikan gameplay terkait Interboo untuk mendapatkan Mindscape Agen Pyrois, W-Engine Eksklusif Agen Pyrois "Sol Exuvia", Polychrome, dan berbagai hadiah material pengembangan. (* Hadiah akan terus bertambah seiring pembaruan versi berikutnya.) Waktu Buka: Setelah update V3.0 Syarat Partisipasi: Telah membuka "Interboo" dalam misi "Celestial Nexus" di Cerita Utama Season 3 Chapter 1 untuk dapat berpartisipasi dalam gameplay peningkatan akun "Interboo". • Roarin' Brekkies Setelah update versi 3.0, setiap hari kamu dapat mengundi satu kali "Kotak Kejutan Camilan" di "Roarin' Brekkies" milik "Tuan Roar" di Roscaelifer untuk mendapatkan "Kartu Data" serta hadiah yang sesuai. Kumpulkan "Kartu Data" dari berbagai tingkat kelangkaan untuk mendapatkan "Tutup Botol Keberuntungan" dan membuat permohonan di "Air Mancur Peri Tutup Botol". * Pengundian "kotak kejutan" berbagi jumlah kesempatan harian dengan Ramalan dan Kartu Gosok. Jika kamu sudah melakukan pengundian "kotak kejutan", maka kamu tidak dapat melakukan Ramalan dan Kartu Gosok pada hari yang sama. • Transit Aerial Proxy dapat memanfaatkan kemampuan spasial milik Pyrois untuk meluncur di sepanjang lintasan dengan cepat ke tempat yang dituju. • Akses Terminal Universal Proxy dapat membuka "Akses Terminal Universal" dan mendapatkan pandangan yang lebih luas melalui sudut pandang orang pertama dari kamera yang tersebar di Kota Roscaelifer, dan Proxy dapat memindai dan mengakses objek tertentu untuk memperoleh informasi penting. • Drone Bangboo Proxy dapat mengoperasikan Eous untuk mengendalikan drone dan berinteraksi. Drone dilengkapi dengan dua Skill: "Charge" dan "Destroy". Saat mendekati target yang bisa diisi daya dengan "Charge" akan muncul indikator koneksi. Sedangkan saat mendekati target yang bisa dihancurkan, target akan ditandai dengan indikator "Destroy" khusus. Proxy dapat mengikuti panduan untuk mengoperasikan dan mengaktifkan Skill drone. • Kebocoran Singularitas Setelah Proxy mengaktifkan "Kebocoran Singularitas", lingkungan, objek, dan musuh di area sekitar akan berubah. Proxy dapat menghilangkan "Kebocoran Singularitas" dan keluar menggunakan kemampuan Pyrois. IX. Konten Update Lainnya ▶ Konten Baru • Menambahkan tantangan "Mekanik dan Pemberontak" di "Patroli Area". Setelah menyelesaikan tantangan, kamu bisa mendapatkan set Drive Disc baru "Wuthering Salon" dan "The Sky Ablaze". • Menambahkan musuh "Integrated: Primordial Nightmare - The Creator", "Girtablullu", "Metamorphosed - Avarus", "Metamorphosed - Scorpse", "Autonomous Assault Unit - Airspace Sentinel", "Doppelganger - Starlight - Billy", "Shining Promise - Billy", "Metamorphosed - Tarasque Mixer", "City Guardboo", "Lahmu", "Mutant Formicarrier", "Metamorphosed - Beholder Engine", "Airspace Patrolboo", "Special Anti-Riotboo", "Metamorphosed - Airspace Patrolboo", "Metamorphosed - Special Anti-Riotboo", "Kulullu". • Menambahkan area baru "Central Computing Department", "Koridor Tenggelam", dan "Zona Energi". • Menambahkan konten peta terkait adegan dan gameplay versi 3.0 di sistem "Peta". Saat "Ruang Tersembunyi" dan "Kebocoran Singularitas" diaktifkan, informasi area pada peta juga akan berubah secara bersamaan. Pergerakan bus terbang di kota juga akan ditampilkan secara real-time di peta. • Menambahkan Wallpaper Dinamis Agen Velina dan Norma. Setelah mendapatkan dan meningkatkan Level Kepercayaan Agen, pemain dapat membuka Wallpaper Dinamis dari Agen terkait. • Menambahkan pencapaian terkait "Riwayat Phaethon", "Kepercayaan Agen", "Momen Tepat", "Bisnis Proxy", "Booastrum", "Teknik Bertarung", "Target Musuh", "Pencapaian Pertarungan", "Eksplorasi Area", termasuk beberapa Pencapaian Tersembunyi. • Menambahkan gelar terkait "Kepercayaan Agen", "target musuh", "Roarin' Brekkies", Event "Bangbang! Si Jenius dan Chip Ajaib!", dan Event "Pertarungan dalam Bayangan". Di antaranya, gelar event hanya dapat diperoleh dalam waktu terbatas. • Menambahkan set trofi baru ke platform PS5™: Zenless Zone Zero - "Pengakuan Seorang Parasomnia". • Menambahkan pencapaian untuk platform Xbox Series X | S. • Menambahkan misi sampingan eksplorasi "Ruang Tersembunyi". • Menambahkan video "Demo Event" pada beberapa tab event. • Menambahkan kolom sumber daya baru di pojok kanan atas antarmuka "Panduan" yang menampilkan jumlah spesifik "Battery", "Backup Battery", dan "Ether Battery". • Menambahkan tampilan jumlah sub-stat efektif Drive Disc pada antarmuka Detail Agen setelah memenuhi kondisi pengembangan tertentu. • Menambahkan fitur Buang Otomatis pada Bongkar Drive Disc, Proxy dapat membuang Drive Disc yang tidak diperlukan secara sekaligus sesuai kebutuhan. • Menambahkan fitur "Ganti Target Latihan" pada antarmuka Kustomisasi Drive Disc, sehingga memprioritaskan tampilan Agen terkait untuk Set 4 Bagian dan Agen terkait untuk Set 2 Bagian berdasarkan rencana target latihan. • Stat Utama "Wind DMG Bonus" telah ditambahkan ke Drive Disc slot 5. • Menambahkan fitur "Istilah" pada teks "Deskripsi Skill" Agen V3.0 dan seterusnya, serta pada dalam "Detail Musuh". Proxy dapat menekan istilah tertentu yang memiliki garis bawah untuk melihat penjelasan lengkapnya. • Menambahkan tampilan chapter Cerita Utama season terbaru beserta label chapter terbaru di "Jadwal Inter-Knot", memudahkan Proxy untuk berpartisipasi dan menemukan chapter Cerita Utama terbaru dengan cepat. • Menambahkan item koleksi baru "Catatan Keseharian Kota: Memancing di Kota" yang dapat ditukarkan di "Sān-Z STUDIO". • Menambahkan Denny yang dapat ditukarkan di "Suibian Temple" - "Toko Gadai Devon". • Menambahkan kamar tidur Proxy di "Amber Hall". • Menambahkan papan Faksi "External Strategy Department" di "Meja Kerja" - "Arsip Kolaborasi". ▶ Toko Sinyal • Menambahkan hadiah "Momen Bersiap" di "Toko" - "Toko Sinyal" - "Residual Signal". Proxy dapat menukarkan hadiah "Momen Bersiap" satu kali setiap bulan untuk memilih W-Engine Tier-A dari "FM Stabil". Menambahkan "Advanced Windbite Chip" di "Fading Signal" dengan batas penukaran 50 kali setiap bulan. Selain itu, menambahkan "Advanced Attack Certification Seal", "Advanced Stun Certification Seal", "Advanced Anomaly Certification Seal", "Advanced Support Certification Seal", "Advanced Defense Certification Seal", "Advanced Rupture Certification Seal", "Reinforced Attack Component", "Reinforced Stun Component", "Reinforced Anomaly Component", "Reinforced Support Component", "Reinforced Defense Component", "Reinforced Rupture Component", dengan masing-masing batas penukaran 35 kali setiap bulan. ▶ Shiyu Defense Setelah update V3.0, Critical Node akan memiliki efek buff berikut: Tahap 1: • Wind DMG dan Ice DMG yang diakibatkan Agen meningkat 30%, dan DMG yang diakibatkan Vortex meningkat 30%. Setelah Agen melancarkan EX Special Attack, Anomaly Proficiency Agen meningkat 40 poin selama 15 detik. Memicu ulang akan memperbarui durasi. • Ether DMG Agen meningkat 30%, CRIT DMG meningkat 40%. Setelah serangan Agen spesialisasi Attack mengenai musuh dan memicu CRIT, DEF musuh akan berkurang 10% selama 5 detik. Memicu ulang akan memperbarui durasi. • Ether Anomaly Buildup Rate dan Ice Anomaly Buildup Rate Agen meningkat 25%. Setelah Agen mengakibatkan status Attribute Anomaly terhadap musuh, DEF musuh akan berkurang 10% dan Attribute Anomaly DMG yang diterima akan meningkat 20% selama 10 detik. Memicu ulang akan memperbarui durasi. Tahap 2: • Wind DMG dan Ice DMG Agen meningkat 10%. Saat mengenai musuh yang sedang terpengaruh Attribute Anomaly, ATK meningkat 15% dan 10% ketahanan semua atribut musuh tersebut akan diabaikan. • DMG yang diakibatkan Ultimate dan Chain Attack Agen meningkat 40%. Setelah Chain Attack mengenai musuh, Kelipatan Stun DMG musuh meningkat 20% dan kecepatan pulih dari status Stun menurun 15% selama 15 detik. Memicu ulang akan memperbarui durasi. • ATK Agen meningkat 30%, CRIT DMG meningkat 15%. Kelipatan Stun DMG musuh meningkat 20%. Tahap 3: • DMG yang diakibatkan Chain Attack dan Ultimate Agen meningkat 40%. Setelah Chain Attack mengenai musuh, Kelipatan Stun DMG musuh meningkat 20% dan kecepatan pulih dari status Stun menurun 15% selama 15 detik. Memicu ulang akan memperbarui durasi. • Anomaly Proficiency Agen meningkat 20 poin, Anomaly DMG yang diakibatkan meningkat 10%. Jika ada 1/2 Agen spesialisasi Anomaly di dalam tim, Agen akan mengabaikan 5%/15% Ketahanan semua DMG musuh. • Ice DMG Agen meningkat 30%. DMG dari Basic Attack dan Chain Attack Agen meningkat 20%, serta CRIT DMG meningkat 35%. ▶ Operasi Serbuan Maut Setelah update V3.0, musuh yang perlu dihadapi di Operasi Serbuan Maut kali ini sebagai berikut: Tahap 1: Girtablullu, Notorious - Marionette, Ye Shiyuan the Thrall Tahap 2: Girtablullu, Primordial Nightmare - "The Creator", Ye Shiyuan the Thrall Tahap 3: Scorched Horizon - Phaethon, Notorious - Pompey, Miasmic Fiend - Unfathomable ※ Waktu berakhir "Operasi Serbuan Maut" periode ketiga dari V3.0 telah diubah dari 2026/07/31 03:59 (waktu server) menjadi 2026/07/29 03:59 (waktu server). Ayo segera ikuti serta event-nya. ▶ Hollow Zero • Menambahkan entri "Misi Khusus" serta hadiah terkait. • Menambahkan Skema Prisma Taktis untuk Agen Velina, Norma, dan Pyrois, beserta "Misi Khusus" yang sesuai. (Skema Prisma Taktis Norma akan terbuka bersamaan dengan FM Eksklusif-nya) [Penyesuaian dan Optimalisasi] ▶ Agen • Menyesuaikan penempatan sebagian teks Mindscape Cinema Agen Astra Yao dan Evelyn: Deskripsi terkait Mindscape Cinema 01 "12-Tone Equal Temperament" milik Agen "Astra Yao" dan Mindscape Cinema 01 "Dreamweave" milik "Evelyn" telah dihapus dari "Penjelasan Pengaturan Tim Eksplorasi Area". Keterangan efek Mindscape Cinema dapat dipicu maksimal sekali setiap 180 detik dalam "Mode Eksplorasi Area" telah dipindahkan ke teks antarmuka Mindscape Cinema. Penyesuaian ini hanya merupakan perubahan penempatan teks dan tidak memengaruhi efek Mindscape Cinema yang sebenarnya. ▶ Sistem • Menyesuaikan konten "Jalan Bersama" dan "Insiden Kepercayaan" untuk Agen versi 3.0 dan seterusnya. Penyesuaian ini tidak memengaruhi jumlah hadiah Polychrome, namun akan mempercepat efisiensi peningkatan level "Kepercayaan". • Menyesuaikan tampilan "Penilaian Persiapan Pertempuran" di antarmuka Detail Agen, sehingga lebih mudah melihat aspek mana yang perlu ditingkatkan agar bisa melakukan pengembangan dengan mudah. • Mengoptimalisasi gaya tampilan antarmuka "Agen" - "Skill" - "Rekomendasi Peningkatan". • Menyesuaikan sistem aksesori Outfit Proxy. Topi, hiasan kepala, anting, dan kacamata kini disesuaikan menjadi aksesori Outfit umum untuk Proxy, sehingga dapat dikombinasikan secara bebas dengan semua Outfit Proxy. • Mengoptimalisasi detail pencahayaan menyeluruh dan model perspektif jauh di versi PC. Perangkat yang dilengkapi kartu grafis NVIDIA GeForce RTX 20 ke atas (dengan unit Ray Tracing RT Core dan VRAM minimal 8GB) mendukung fitur Ray Tracing. Selain itu, menambahkan fitur Frame Generation dan Super Resolution DLSS/FSR3. ▶ Lainnya • Mengoptimalisasi beberapa format tampilan. • Mengoptimalisasi beberapa tampilan model NPC "Remielle" dan "Velina". • Mengoptimalisasi sulih suara Bahasa Inggris, Bahasa Jepang, dan Bahasa Korea di beberapa alur cerita dan pertarungan di versi sebelumnya. [Perbaikan Masalah] ▶ Agen dan Musuh • Memperbaiki masalah di mana musuh "Scorched Horizon - Phaethon" dapat menerima DMG "Vortex" secara tidak normal setelah mengaktifkan status "Gale Scorcher" dalam kondisi tertentu. • Memperbaiki masalah pemulihan "Burning Tether Point" yang abnormal untuk Agen "Evelyn" dalam kondisi tertentu. • Memperbaiki deskripsi teks Mindscape Cinema 04 Agen Cissia "A Rogue's Resolve" pada antarmuka Mindscape Cinema, agar sesuai dengan teks pada antarmuka Mindscape Cinema dalam pertarungan. Penyesuaian ini hanya untuk revisi teks dan tidak memengaruhi efek Skill yang sebenarnya. Sebelum diperbaiki: Setiap 1 lapis yang dikonsumsi memicu tambahan 1 kali Corrode Bone tanpa mengonsumsi Venom Setelah diperbaiki: Setiap 1 lapis yang dikonsumsi akan memicu tambahan 1 kali Corrode Bone khusus tanpa mengonsumsi Venom • Memperbaiki masalah di mana bar HP musuh ditampilkan secara tidak normal selama pertarungan dalam kondisi tertentu. • Memperbaiki masalah model tiga Agen yang saling tumpang tindih saat "Aria" berada satu tim dengan "Nangong Yu" dan "Sunna" dalam pertarungan ketika Aria menggunakan Basic Attack: Sweet Melody dalam kondisi tertentu. • Memperbaiki masalah model Agen yang kemungkinan tumpang tindih setelah Agen memicu Quick Assist dalam kondisi tertentu. • Memperbaiki masalah di Hollow Zero pada Skill "Dash Attack: Oopsy-Daisy! - Modified" milik Agen "Corin" yang kemungkinan bisa aktif secara abnormal setelah mendapatkan senjata "Tea Break Time" dan "Chainsaw Driving Guide". • Memperbaiki masalah pada Agen "Starlight - Billy" yang kemungkinan mengalami getaran abnormal untuk Skill tertentu dalam pertarungan setelah mengaktifkan fitur "Sensor Haptik". • Memperbaiki masalah pada skill Agen Soukaku "Quick Assist: A Set for Two" dan "Dodge Counter: Away From My Snacks" yang dapat terpicu secara tidak normal. Penyesuaian ini tidak memengaruhi jumlah pemulihan Decibel saat skill mengenai musuh. ▶ Sistem • Menyesuaikan pengaturan default opsi "Ray Tracing" pada PS5™ Pro dan Xbox Series X. Setelah update, "Ray Tracing" akan dinonaktifkan secara default. Selain itu, intensitas filter warna juga akan dikembalikan ke pengaturan default. • Memperbaiki masalah pada indikator "New" yang tidak bisa dihilangkan secara normal dalam kondisi tertentu. ▶ Musik & Efek Suara • Memperbaiki masalah musik dan efek suara yang kemungkinan abnormal dalam beberapa situasi tertentu. ▶ Lainnya • Memperbaiki masalah teks pada beberapa misi, antarmuka, dan deskripsi. • Memperbaiki kesalahan penulisan pada sebagian teks. • Menyesuaikan, mengoptimalisasi, dan memperbaiki beberapa teks dalam game (tidak akan memengaruhi gameplay atau sistem).

desc.en: Dear Proxies, To reduce the impact brought about by abnormal Hollow fluctuations and ensure Proxies can live happily in New Eridu, we will make sure to take everyone's feedback into account and promptly address any issues that arise. [Known Issues] June 29 • There is a known issue for iOS devices that may prevent the sharing of content to X. This issue is expected to be fixed in a future update. June 17 • There is a known issue that there might be some abnormal action sound effects when Agent Velina is in the city area. • There is a known issue where, after updating to Version 3.0, the game window may display an abnormal resolution upon first launching the PC client. If Proxies run into this issue, you can manually adjust the resolution to a suitable setting in the game options. • There is a known issue in certain story voiceovers in Version 3.0 where some abnormal behavior occurs with the Chinese, Japanese, English, and Korean voiceovers when 2x playback speed is enabled. • There is a known issue where Sony Xperia 1 VIII, Sony Xperia 1 VII, and subsequent Sony devices equipped with Snapdragon 8 Elite or 5th Gen Snapdragon 8 Elite processors may experience intermittent lag and stuttering that disrupt normal gameplay. Proxies are advised to switch to a different device to experience the game. • When the NVIDIA graphics card driver version on your PC: i. Is lower than 591.74 (Jan 2026), enabling DX12 mode may cause UI or scene texture display anomalies or crashes. Proxies are advised to update their NVIDIA graphics card drivers before enabling DX12 mode. ii. Is updated to 610.47 (May 2026), enabling Smooth Motion in the NVIDIA app may cause the game to crash. If Proxies encounter this issue, please navigate to NVIDIA App > Graphics > Global Settings > Smooth Motion and disable the option. We will fix this issue in an upcoming update. Thanks for your patience and support, Proxies! • Some Honor and OnePlus devices may experience screen flickering or game freezing issues. If Proxies encounter this issue, head to Settings - System & Updates - Software Update - tap the three dots in the top right - Advanced Upgrade to get the fixed version. • On Windows 10 in DX12 mode, launching OBS with the source set to [Game Capture] may cause the game to crash. If Proxies run into this issue, just close OBS before starting the game, and you should be good to go. [Issue Fixes & Optimizations Summary] July 24 Update Details • In-game text adjustments, improvements, and fixes for some languages. These changes will not affect gameplay. July 13 Update Details • Fixes an issue where Proxies experiencing the "Bangbang! The Genius and the Miracle Chip!" event on a mobile device with a connected controller were unable to return to the previous screen after entering the Collaboorator Level interface. July 7 Update Details • Fixes an issue where the game might crash unexpectedly during the "Thracian: Data" Stress Test stage of the "Bangbang! The Genius and the Miracle Chip!" event under certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue where the NPC Crowe failed to appear properly under certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue where the Special District Archives for Crowe would not unlock properly in the Interboo after talking to NPC Crowe under certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue where some Hearsay Missions could not be accepted under certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue where the Infrasonic Generator was displayed abnormally under certain circumstances. • In-game text adjustments, improvements, and fixes for some languages. These changes will not affect gameplay. July 2 Update Details • Fixes an issue in the event "Bangbang! The Genius and the Miracle Chip" where repeatedly challenging the "Stress Test" could cause Proxy rankings to display incorrectly. July 1 Update Details • Fixes an issue where some visual effects for Agent Velina are displayed abnormally while in combat. • Fixes an issue where the names of Files 01 and 02 in Agent Velina's Video Archive in the Partner Archive were displayed abnormally. • Fixes the text descriptions for some of Agent Norma's skills and Mindscapes. These are textual adjustments and do not affect actual effects. • Fixes an issue where the Polychrome Guide displayed available events incorrectly under certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue where, under certain circumstances, Proxies were unable to enter the tracks to continue progressing the mission after completing the Aerial Transit gameplay tutorial. • Fixes an issue where Proxies were unable to return via the elevator during the "The Mist of Dark Alleys" mission under certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue where, under specific circumstances, some functions' red dot notifications would not display correctly after equipping the Bangboo Bus menu decoration theme. • Fixes an issue where the Bangboo Ultra Jake's model behaves abnormally under certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue where players could not move normally after interacting with NPC Reginald under certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue where some enemies in the Scamall Hollow do not spawn properly. • Fixes an issue in the "The Genius and the Miracle Chip!" event where the new unlocked content description text was displayed abnormally when upgrading the Central Computing Hub to level 9. • Fixes an issue where the Agent's leaning effect was abnormal when turning during movement under specific circumstances. • Fixes an issue in the Polychrome Guide where the Hollow Zero Bounty Commissions event redirection was not functioning correctly. • Fixes an issue where Proxies were unable to properly complete missions during the Agent Story "It's Me... Leave a Message (III)" while in Roscaelifer. • Fixes an issue where, after selecting Burnice as the Auxiliary Agent to complete a challenge in the current Hollow Zero: Operation Matrix, the Task Force Supply could not be properly obtained. • In-game text adjustments, improvements, and fixes for some languages. These changes will not affect gameplay. June 23 Update Details • Fixes an issue where, under certain circumstances, when certain enemies' attacks trigger Agent Promeia's EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow, the Absolute Order effect would not end properly when Promeia subsequently chains into Special Attack: Execution - Layered Frost. • Fixes an issue where the best score for the Lv. 60 stage of Stress Test in the "Bangbang! The Genius and the Miracle Chip" gameplay mode was not updating properly under certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue where, under specific circumstances in Hollow Zero: Operation Matrix, when the squad configuration includes Tsukishiro Yanagi and Burnice is set as the Auxiliary Agent, some Polarity Disorder effects might not trigger properly after activating the Auxiliary Assist. • Fixes an issue where, after Agent Nangong Yu activates Mindscape 02 Painless Tears, the Polarity Disorder effect triggered on enemies by Additional Ability: Angel Captain would behave abnormally under certain circumstances. [Compensation Details] Polychrome ×100 Compensation will be issued via in-game mail within 24 hours. [Mail Acceptance Deadline] 2026/07/23 23:59 Please accept this mail before the deadline. Mail expires 30 days after acceptance, so please claim the compensation in time. [Compensation Eligibility] Proxies who have reached Inter-Knot Lv. 4 before 2026/06/23 21:00 June 22 Update Details • Fixes visual issues affecting the models for some NPCs. • Fixes an issue where Agent Nicole's model behaves abnormally under certain circumstances while wearing the Cunning Cutie outfit. • Fixes an issue where the Investigation Zone Squad function could not be unlocked properly under certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue where the server-wide rankings on the detail pages of the badges "Annihilation: Primordial Nightmare," "Annihilation: Drowned Ideal," and "Annihilation: Shining Promise" are displayed abnormally. • In-game text adjustments, improvements, and fixes for some languages. These changes will not affect gameplay. June 19 Update Details • In-game text and audio adjustments, improvements, and fixes for some languages. These changes will not affect gameplay. • Fixed an issue where the game frequently crashed upon launch when running the iOS 27 Developer Preview system. Proxies who have upgraded their iOS devices to this system should head to the App Store to update to the latest game version. June 18 Update Details • Fixes an issue where, under certain circumstances, the Proxy might be shifted to an abnormal position after taking the air bus. • Fixes an issue where mission guidance would function abnormally during the mission "Defeat the Ethereals before you" under certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue where the drone interface would abnormally persist on-screen while the Proxy is in the Booastrum district under certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue where the "Unlock Agent Mindscape" numerical display on the "The Day the Sun Went Out" event interface was shown incorrectly under certain circumstances. June 17 Update Details • Fixes an issue where interacting with certain NPCs or city objects can cause an abnormal black screen in certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue where the text in the guidance pop-up interface is displayed abnormally during the "A Sleepwalker's Confession" main story under certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue where the tutorial interface for the Suibian Temple management gameplay is displayed abnormally under certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue where the mission "Draw a Snack Surprise Box" might not be properly completed after drawing a surprise box under certain circumstances. • Fixes an issue where, under certain circumstances, players were unable to enter and challenge stages after accessing the "Annihilation Simulacrum" event. • Fixes an issue where the screen might abnormally go black during Burnice's Trust Mission "A Matter of Prestige" under certain circumstances. • Optimizes the mission conditions required to obtain exclusive rewards in the "Annihilation Simulacrum" event. Proxies are advised to log in to the game again to refresh the updated mission conditions. • Fixes an issue where the "Unlock Talent" and "Skill Enhancement" buttons on the Agent interface are unresponsive on certain devices under certain circumstances. • In-game text and audio adjustments, improvements, and fixes for some languages. These changes will not affect gameplay. • Fixes an issue where there might be some abnormal action sound effects when Agent Promeia is in the city area. • Optimizes the recommendations for Drive Disc sets and partition main stats in Agent Velina's Special Training Plan.
desc.id: Dear Proxy: Demi mengurangi dampak dari fluktuasi anomali Hollow, kami akan memastikan untuk selalu mendengarkan masukan dari kalian. Kami juga akan merespons dan menangani berbagai masalah yang teridentifikasi dengan cepat untuk memastikan kehidupan sehari-hari kalian di New Eridu berjalan lancar. [Masalah yang Sudah Teridentifikasi] 29 Juni • Telah teridentifikasi masalah di mana konten kemungkinan tidak dapat dibagikan ke X pada perangkat iOS. Masalah ini diperkirakan akan diperbaiki pada update mendatang. 17 Juni • Telah teridentifikasi masalah pada beberapa efek suara aksi Agen "Velina" saat berada di area kota. • Telah teridentifikasi masalah resolusi pada window game saat pertama kali menjalankan klien PC setelah update versi 3.0. Apabila Proxy mengalami masalah ini, silakan sesuaikan resolusi yang tepat secara manual di pengaturan game. • Telah teridentifikasi masalah pada sulih suara untuk sebagian cerita di versi 3.0, di mana saat pemutaran 2x kecepatan diaktifkan, suara dalam bahasa Mandarin, Jepang, Inggris, dan Korea mengalami beberapa anomali. • Diketahui bahwa perangkat Sony Xperia 1 VIII, Sony Xperia 1 VII, serta perangkat Sony seri berikutnya yang menggunakan Snapdragon 8 Elite dan Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 saat ini mengalami masalah lag dan stuttering yang dapat menyebabkan game tidak berjalan dengan normal. Proxy disarankan menggunakan perangkat lain untuk pengalaman bermain yang lebih baik. • Saat memeriksa versi driver kartu grafis Nvidia di PC: 1. Jika versi di bawah 591.74 (2026.01), mengaktifkan mode DX12 mungkin akan membuat tampilan UI atau tekstur lingkungan menjadi tidak normal atau mengakibatkan game mengalami crash. Harap Proxy memperbarui driver kartu grafis NVIDIA sebelum mengaktifkan mode DX12. 2. Saat diperbarui ke versi 610.47 (2026.05), mengaktifkan AI Frame Generation di aplikasi Nvidia dapat mengakibatkan game mengalami crash. Jika Proxy mengalami masalah ini, harap nonaktifkan opsi tersebut melalui Aplikasi Nvidia - Graphics > Global Settings > Smooth Motion. Kami akan memperbaiki masalah ini pada update mendatang. Terima kasih atas pengertian dan dukungannya, Proxy. • Beberapa perangkat Honor dan OnePlus kemungkinan dapat mengalami masalah layar berkedip dan lag. title.en: Zenless Zone Zero PC Visual Experience Upgrade FAQ
title.id: FAQ Fitur Peningkatan Pengalaman Visual Versi PC Zenless Zone Zero

subtitle.id: FAQ Fitur Peningkatan Pengalaman Visual Versi PC

desc.en: Dear Proxies, with the Version 3.0 update, the PC visual experience gets a major upgrade — featuring Global Illumination upgrades, Ray Tracing, Super Resolution & Frame Generation. We've pulled together the latest updates here to help answer your most common questions about using these functions. Q1: What devices support DX12, and how do you enable it? Devices with NVIDIA 20 Series or higher graphics cards (that include RT Cores) support running the game in DX12 mode. Eligible devices will show a DX12 activation option below the Start Game button on the launcher. Select it to launch the game in DX12 mode. To switch back to the more compatible DX11 mode, simply uncheck it. Q2: Any recommended GPU driver versions? It is recommended to update your NVIDIA graphics driver to Version 591.86 (release date: 2026/01/27) or later. Using outdated drivers may cause known visual anomalies or compatibility issues. It's recommended that you update your drivers, Proxies. Download Driver Q3: What is shader compilation? What should I watch out for? When launching the game in DX12 mode for the first time, shader compilation will trigger automatically. This may cause brief stutters, which are completely normal. Just hang tight and wait for it to be completed! If the compilation process gets interrupted unexpectedly, you can use the Repair Tool on the launcher screen to launch shader compilation again. Q4: What devices support Ray Tracing? Ray Tracing requires a device equipped with an NVIDIA 20 Series or higher GPU (that includes RT Cores). ※Excludes devices with less than 8GB of VRAM. Recommended Hardware Specs: Resolution Recommended Graphics Card 1080p Devices with 8GB VRAM or above 1440p (2K) NVIDIA RTX 3080 / RTX 4070 or above 2160p (4K) NVIDIA RTX 3090 / RTX 4080 / RTX 5080 or above ※ When enabling Ray Tracing, it is recommended to also enable DLSS Super Resolution, so as to enhance the image quality while enjoying a smoother gameplay experience. ※ Ray Tracing is currently only supported in city scenes and select combat scenes. In all other scenes, it will automatically switch back to the default global illumination setting. Q5: How do I enable the Ray Tracing function? Proxies can enable this feature in-game via Options → Graphics → Advanced → Ray Tracing. ※ When Ray Tracing is enabled, the [Global Illumination] and [Anti-Aliasing] options will not be adjustable. Use [Ray Tracing Level] to select different quality presets. Default options are recommended for the best experience. ※ The team is actively working on compatibility for more devices and continuously optimizing performance for already-supported devices. Future updates will gradually roll out support for more GPU models, so stay tuned to official announcements, Proxies! Q6: What devices support the Super Resolution function, and how do you enable it? Devices equipped with NVIDIA 20 Series or higher graphics cards (that include RT Cores) support enabling DLSS or FSR Super Resolution technology. Proxies can enable this feature in-game via Options → Display → Advanced → Super Resolution, where you can choose between [DLSS] and [FSR] modes. ※ When Super Resolution is enabled, the [Anti-Aliasing] and [Rendering] options will not be adjustable. Use the [Super Resolution Quality Level] setting to balance image quality and frame rate performance. Q7: What devices can support the Frame Generation function? Modes Supported Graphics Card Range DLSS Frame Generation NVIDIA 40 Series or above FSR Frame Generation NVIDIA 20 Series or above (with RT Cores) ※ DLSS Frame Generation currently supports 2× frame generation mode. The team is working on adapting dynamic multi-frame generation. Stay tuned to official channels for updates, Proxies. Q8: How do I enable the Frame Generation function? Before enabling, Proxies should complete the following system options: Go to Windows System → Display → Graphics → Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling, set it to [On], then restart your PC before launching the game. ※ If you experience frame drops, stuttering, or other performance issues after enabling frame generation, please first confirm that the system options mentioned above have been enabled. If the issue persists, please contact our official customer support. Proxies can head to Options → Graphics → Advanced → Frame Generation in-game to enable [DLSS Frame Generation] or [FSR Frame Generation]. ※ When Frame Generation is enabled, the [Super Resolution] option will not be adjustable. For the best experience, it's recommended to also disable Vertical Sync and set the FPS to [Unlimited] or [60].
desc.id: Dear Proxy: setelah update versi 3.0, pengalaman visual versi PC akan ditingkatkan dengan menambahkan fitur peningkatan pencahayaan menyeluruh, Ray Tracing, serta Super Resolution & Frame Generation. Di sini kami telah merangkum konten update terkait, dengan harapan dapat menjawab pertanyaan umum yang sering muncul saat menggunakan fitur-fitur ini. Q1：Perangkat apa yang mendukung DX12 dan bagaimana cara mengaktifkannya? Perangkat dengan kartu grafis NVIDIA 20 ke atas (termasuk unit Ray Tracing RT Core) dapat menjalankan game dalam mode DX12. Perangkat yang memenuhi syarat akan menampilkan opsi pengaktifan DX12 di bawah tombol "Mulai" pada antarmuka launcher. Pilih opsi tersebut untuk menjalankan game dalam mode DX12. Jika ingin beralih kembali ke mode DX11 yang kompatibilitasnya lebih luas, cukup batalkan pilihan. Q2: Versi driver kartu grafis apa yang direkomendasikan? Disarankan untuk memperbarui driver kartu grafis NVIDIA ke versi 591.86 (rilis pada 2026/01/27) atau lebih tinggi. Menggunakan driver versi lama secara umum dapat menyebabkan masalah tampilan atau masalah kompatibilitas. Proxy disarankan untuk segera memperbaruinya. Unduh Driver Q3: Apa itu kompilasi shader? Apa yang perlu diperhatikan? Saat menjalankan game dalam mode DX12 untuk pertama kalinya, kompilasi shader akan aktif secara otomatis. Proses ini mungkin menyebabkan lag sesaat dan merupakan hal yang normal. Mohon tunggu dengan sabar hingga prosesnya selesai ya, Proxy~ Jika program terhenti secara tidak terduga selama proses kompilasi, kamu dapat menggunakan alat perbaikan di launcher untuk memulai ulang kompilasi shader. Q4: Perangkat apa saja yang mendukung fitur Ray Tracing? Fitur Ray Tracing memerlukan perangkat dengan kartu grafis NVIDIA 20 ke atas (termasuk unit Ray Tracing RT Core). ※ Tidak termasuk perangkat dengan VRAM di bawah 8GB. Spesifikasi yang direkomendasikan: Resolusi Kartu grafis yang direkomendasikan 1080p Perangkat dengan VRAM 8GB atau lebih 1440p (2K) NVIDIA RTX 3080 / RTX 4070 ke atas 2160p (4K) NVIDIA RTX 3090 / RTX 4080 / RTX 5080 atau ke atas ※ Saat mengaktifkan Ray Tracing, disarankan untuk mengaktifkan DLSS Super Resolution secara bersamaan untuk meningkatkan kualitas visual sehingga dapat memberikan pengalaman bermain yang lebih lancar sekaligus mempertahankan kualitas visual. ※ Ray Tracing saat ini hanya mendukung area kota dan sebagian latar pertarungan. Pada latar lainnya, sistem akan otomatis beralih ke penerangan menyeluruh secara default. Q5: Bagaimana cara mengaktifkan fitur Ray Tracing? Proxy dapat mengaktifkan fitur ini di dalam game melalui "Setelan" → "Grafik" → "Lanjutan" → "Ray Tracing". ※ Setelah mengaktifkan Ray Tracing, opsi "Penerangan Menyeluruh" dan "Anti-aliasing" tidak dapat diubah. Kamu dapat memilih tingkat kualitas gambar melalui "Tingkat Ray Tracing". Disarankan menggunakan pengaturan default untuk pengalaman terbaik. ※ Saat ini tim pengembang terus mengupayakan kompatibilitas untuk lebih banyak perangkat serta terus mengoptimalkan performa perangkat yang sudah didukung. Pembaruan mendatang juga akan secara bertahap meluncurkan dukungan untuk lebih banyak model GPU. Pantau terus pengumuman resmi selanjutnya ya, Proxy! Q6: Perangkat apa saja yang mendukung fitur Super Resolution dan bagaimana cara mengaktifkannya? Perangkat dengan NVIDIA 20 ke atas (termasuk unit Ray Tracing RT Core) mendukung Super Resolution DLSS atau FSR. Proxy dapat mengaktifkan fitur ini di dalam game melalui "Setelan" → "Grafik" → "Lanjutan" → "Super Resolution", dan dapat memilih antara dua mode: "DLSS" dan "FSR". ※ Setelah Super Resolution diaktifkan, opsi "Anti-aliasing" dan "Rendering" tidak dapat diubah. Jika ingin menyeimbangkan kualitas gambar dan performa frame rate, kamu dapat menyesuaikannya melalui "Tingkat Kualitas Super Resolution". Q7: Perangkat apa saja yang mendukung fitur Frame Generation? Mode Kartu grafis yang didukung Frame Generation DLSS NVIDIA Seri 40 ke atas Frame Generation FSR NVIDIA 20 ke atas (termasuk unit Ray Tracing RT Core) ※ Saat ini fitur Frame Generation DLSS mendukung mode Frame Generation 2x. Tim pengembang sedang mengupayakan untuk mengadaptasi fitur Dynamic Multi-frame Generation. Pantau terus pengumuman resmi selanjutnya ya, Proxy! Q8: Bagaimana cara mengaktifkan fitur Frame Generation? Sebelum mengaktifkan, harap selesaikan pengaturan sistem berikut: Buka "Pengaturan Sistem Windows" → "Tampilan" → "Pengaturan Grafis" → "HAGS", lalu ubah menjadi "Aktif", kemudian restart komputer sebelum memulai game. ※ Jika terjadi masalah performa seperti frame drop atau lag setelah mengaktifkan Frame Generation, harap pastikan pengaturan sistem yang disebutkan di atas telah diaktifkan. Jika masalah masih belum teratasi, silakan hubungi Layanan Pelanggan resmi. Proxy dapat membuka "Setelan" → "Grafik" → "Lanjutan" → "Frame Generation" di dalam game, lalu pilih untuk mengaktifkan "DLSS" atau "FSR". ※ Setelah Frame Generation diaktifkan, opsi "Super Resolution" tidak dapat diubah. Disarankan untuk menonaktifkan V-Sync sekaligus mengatur batas FPS ke "Tanpa Batas" atau "60" untuk pengalaman terbaik.

desc.en: Dear Proxies, Version 3.1 is now available for pre-download. Proxies can follow the instructions below to download part of the files in advance. This will allow you to access the game faster once the update maintenance ends. [Pre-Download Period] 2026/07/27 12:00 (UTC+8) – 2026/07/29 05:50 (UTC+8) [Pre-Download Details] ● PC The pre-download file is about 11 GB. ● Mobile (Android and iOS) The pre-download file is about 7 GB. ● PS5™ or PS5™ Pro The pre-download file is about 25 GB. ● Xbox Series X|S The pre-download file is about 26 GB. ※ Due to the large size of the download, please ensure that you have sufficient space on your device and that you download the files using Wi-Fi. ※ The Voice Pack(s) installed on the client will affect the space required for the pre-download. [How to Pre-Download] ● PC Open the HoYoPlay Launcher, and the "Pre-Download" icon will appear next to the "Start Game" button. Click the icon to begin the download. ※ PC users can continue playing the game during the pre-download. ● Mobile (Android and iOS) Open the game and tap the "Pre-Download Resources" icon in the bottom-right corner of the screen to start downloading. ※ Mobile users will not be able to play the game during the pre-download. Please plan your pre-download time accordingly. ● PS5™ or PS5™ Pro After launching Zenless Zone Zero, if the device has sufficient reserved storage space, it will automatically begin the Zenless Zone Zero pre-download after a certain period of time. ※ PS5™ or PS5™ Pro users can continue playing the game during the pre-download. ● Xbox Series X|S After launching Zenless Zone Zero, if the device has sufficient reserved storage space, it will automatically begin the Zenless Zone Zero pre-download after a certain period of time. Proxies can also pre-download Zenless Zone Zero by going to the Xbox Series X|S System's home screen > My games & apps > Manage > Updates page. ※ Xbox Series X|S users can continue playing the game during the pre-download. In addition, the dev team is scheduled to perform version update maintenance. During this time, you will be unable to log into the game . Please stay tuned for info related to the game update. [Version Update Time] 2026/07/29 06:00 (UTC+8) : We estimate this will take five hours. For details on aspects such as new gameplay, optimizations, bug fixes, and compensation, please look out for future version update info. title.id: Penjelasan Masalah yang Teridentifikasi丨"Bangboo" Misterius di Sixth Street

desc.en: Dear Proxies, Since this morning, the production team has received multiple reports from Sixth Street residents regarding the appearance of an "unidentified Bangboo." We immediately investigated the matter but have yet to determine the cause of its appearance. Based on our investigation results, this "Bangboo" may be spotted at the following locations: · Video Store (Seems like they're looking for something...?) · 404 Livehouse (They're clearly appreciating the performance.) · By the sculpture in front of the gadget store (Hey, don't go picking that up!) Currently, the production team is working urgently to resolve the issue. We will also announce the resolution through official channels, so please be patient. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation, Proxies!
desc.id: Dear Proxy: Sejak pagi ini, tim pengembang telah menerima sejumlah laporan dari warga Sixth Street mengenai kemunculan "Bangboo tak dikenal". Kami pun langsung memeriksa masalah tersebut, namun hingga saat ini penyebab kemunculannya masih belum bisa dipastikan. Berdasarkan hasil pemeriksaan, "Bangboo" ini mungkin muncul di lokasi berikut: · Toko Video (Sepertinya dia sedang mencari sesuatu...?) · 404 Live House (Sepertinya dia lumayan menikmati pertunjukan di sana.) · Di samping patung depan toko gadget （Hei—— jangan meniru patungnya ya!） Saat ini, tim pengembang sedang berusaha menyelesaikan masalah ini secepat mungkin. Kami juga akan menginformasikan hasil penanganannya melalui pengumuman resmi. Mohon Proxy bersabar menunggu. Terima kasih atas pengertian dan kerja samanya.
